العثور على شخص لقضاء وقت ممتع معه.

**Option 4 (If "rando" implies someone unpredictable or quirky):**

العثور على شخص غريب الأطوار.

strings.key: Every call goes through our relay, so neither person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.
strings.msgid: Every call goes through our relay, so neither person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: تمر جميع المكالمات عبر نظام إعادة التوجيه الخاص بنا، وبالتالي لا يتمكن أي من الطرفين من رؤية عنوان الطرف الآخر. ونحن نختبر هذا النظام بشكل دوري، كل بضع دقائق، عن طريق إنشاء اتصال حقيقي باستخدام نظام إعادة التوجيه.

hy-mt2.text: كل مكالمة تمر عبر جهاز الإرسال الخاص بنا، لذلك لا يرى أي من الطرفين عنوان الطرف الآخر. نقوم باختبار ذلك كل بضع دقائق عن طريق إنشاء اتصال إرسال حقيقي.
hy-mt2.back_translation: Every call goes through our routing device, so neither party sees the other party’s address. We test this every few minutes by establishing a real routing call.

m2m100.text: كل مكالمة تذهب من خلال إرسالنا ، لذلك لا يرى أي شخص عنوان الآخر ، ونحن نختبرها كل بضع دقائق من خلال إعداد اتصال إرسال حقيقي.
m2m100.back_translation: Each call goes through our sending, so no one sees another address, and we test it every few minutes by setting a real sending connection.

madlad-400.text: كل مكالمة تمر من خلال إعادة الإرسال لدينا، لذلك لا يرى أي شخص عنوان الآخر. نحن نختبره كل بضع دقائق من خلال إنشاء اتصال إعادة إرسال حقيقي.
madlad-400.back_translation: Every call goes through our relay, so no one sees each other’s address. We test it every few minutes by creating a real relay connection.

opus-mt.text: كل اتصال يمر من خلالنا، لذا لا أحد يرى عنوان الآخر، نختبره كل بضع دقائق
opus-mt.back_translation: Every call goes through us, so nobody sees the other's address, we test it every few minutes.

translategemma-12b.text: تُمر جميع المكالمات عبر نظامنا الوسيط، لذلك لا يرى أي من الطرفين عنوان الطرف الآخر. نقوم باختبار هذا النظام بشكل دوري، كل بضع دقائق، من خلال إنشاء اتصال وسيط حقيقي.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: All calls are routed through our intermediary system, so neither party sees the other party's address. We regularly test this system, every few minutes, by establishing a real intermediary connection.

translategemma-27b.text: تمر جميع المكالمات عبر نظام إعادة التوجيه الخاص بنا، وبالتالي لا يتمكن أي من الطرفين من رؤية عنوان الطرف الآخر. ونحن نختبر هذا النظام بشكل دوري، كل بضع دقائق، عن طريق إنشاء اتصال حقيقي باستخدام نظام إعادة التوجيه.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: All calls are routed through our redirection system, meaning neither party can see the other’s caller ID. We also test this system regularly, every few minutes, by initiating an actual call using the redirection system itself.

translategemma-4b.text: كل مكالمة تمر عبر نظامنا، لذلك لا يرى أي من الطرفين عنوان الطرف الآخر. نقوم باختبار النظام كل بضع دقائق عن طريق إنشاء اتصال حقيقي.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: Every call passes through our system, so neither party can see the other's contact information. We test the system every few minutes by establishing a real connection.

strings.key: A conversation lasts %{call} minutes. When time is up, it continues for another %{extension} minutes only if both people choose to, up to %{max} minutes in all. You can leave at any time.
strings.msgid: A conversation lasts %{call} minutes. When time is up, it continues for another %{extension} minutes only if both people choose to, up to %{max} minutes in all. You can leave at any time.
strings.best_why: best of 6 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: একটি কথোপকথন %{call} মিনিট স্থায়ী হয়। সময় শেষ হয়ে গেলে, এটি আরও %{extension} মিনিটের জন্য চলতে পারে, তবে শুধুমাত্র তখনই যখন উভয় ব্যক্তি রাজি থাকে। তবে, মোট সময়সীমা %{max} মিনিটের বেশি হবে না। আপনি যেকোনো সময় কথোপকথনটি শেষ করতে পারেন।

hy-mt2.text: একটি কথোপকথনের সময়কাল হয় %{call} মিনিট। সময় শেষ হয়ে গেলে, উভয় পক্ষ চাইলেই এটি আরও %{extension} মিনিট ধরে চলতে পারে; মোট সময়কাল %{max} মিনিট পর্যন্ত হতে পারে। আপনি যেকোনো সময় চলে যেতে পারেন।
hy-mt2.back_translation: The duration of a conversation is %{call} minutes. When the time is up, it can continue for another %{extension} minutes if both parties wish; the total duration can reach up to %{max} minutes. You can leave at any time.

m2m100.text: একটি আলোচনা %{call} মিনিট দীর্ঘ হয়. যখন সময় শেষ হয়, এটি আরও %{extension} মিনিটের জন্য চালু হয়, শুধুমাত্র যদি দুজনই সিদ্ধান্ত নেয়, সর্বোচ্চ %{max} মিনিট পর্যন্ত. আপনি যে কোন সময় ছেড়ে যেতে পারেন.
m2m100.back_translation: A discussion is %{call} minutes long. when the time ends, it is open for more %{extension} minutes, only if both decide, up to maximum %{max} minutes. you can leave any time.

madlad-400.text: একটি আলাপন %{call} মিনিট স্থায়ী হয়। সময় শেষ হওয়ার পর, এটি আরো %{extension} মিনিট স্থায়ী হবে যদি উভয় ব্যক্তিই তা চায়, সর্বোচ্চ %{max} মিনিট পর্যন্ত। আপনি যে কোনো সময় চলে যেতে পারেন।
madlad-400.back_translation: A conversation lasts %{call} minutes. After the time is up, it will last another %{extension} minute if both parties want it, up to a maximum of %{max} minutes. You can leave at any time.

translategemma-12b.text: একটি কথোপকথন %{call} মিনিট স্থায়ী হয়। সময় শেষ হয়ে গেলে, এটি আরও %{extension} মিনিটের জন্য চলতে পারে, তবে শুধুমাত্র তখনই যখন উভয় ব্যক্তি রাজি থাকে। তবে, মোট সময়সীমা %{max} মিনিটের বেশি হবে না। আপনি যেকোনো সময় কথোপকথনটি শেষ করতে পারেন।
translategemma-12b.back_translation: A conversation lasts for a certain amount of time. Once that time is up, the conversation can continue for an additional amount of time, but only if both parties agree. However, the total duration will not exceed a maximum of a certain amount of time. You can end the conversation at any time.

translategemma-27b.text: একটি কথোপকথন %{call} মিনিট পর্যন্ত চলতে পারে। সময় শেষ হয়ে গেলে, উভয় পক্ষ চাইলে আরও %{extension} মিনিটের জন্য এটি বাড়ানো যেতে পারে, তবে মোট সময় %{max} মিনিটের বেশি হবে না। আপনি যেকোনো সময় এই কথোপকথন থেকে বেরিয়ে যেতে পারেন।
translategemma-27b.back_translation: A conversation can last up to %{call} minutes. If both parties agree, it can be extended for an additional %{extension} minutes, but the total duration will not exceed %{max} minutes. You may end the conversation at any time.

translategemma-4b.text: একটি কথোপকথন %{call} মিনিট পর্যন্ত স্থায়ী হয়। সময় শেষ হয়ে গেলে, যদি উভয় ব্যক্তি চাইলে, এটি আরও %{extension} মিনিট পর্যন্ত চলতে পারে, তবে সর্বোচ্চ %{max} মিনিট পর্যন্ত। আপনি যেকোনো সময় সংযোগ বিচ্ছিন্ন করতে পারেন।
translategemma-4b.back_translation: A conversation can last for up to %{call} minutes. If both parties agree, it can continue for an additional %{extension} minutes, but not exceeding %{max} minutes. You can disconnect the call at any time.

strings.msgid: Every call goes through our relay, so neither person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.

strings.best_text: প্রতিটি কলই আমাদের রিলের মাধ্যমে যায়, তাই কেউই অন্যের ঠিকানা দেখতে পায় না। আমরা প্রতি কয়েক মিনিট অন্তর একটি বাস্তব রিলে সংযোগ স্থাপন করে এটি পরীক্ষা করি।

hy-mt2.text: প্রতিটি কলই আমাদের রিলের মাধ্যমে যায়, তাই কেউই অন্যের ঠিকানা দেখতে পায় না। আমরা প্রতি কয়েক মিনিট অন্তর একটি বাস্তব রিলে সংযোগ স্থাপন করে এটি পরীক্ষা করি।
hy-mt2.back_translation: Every call goes through our relay, so no one can see each other’s addresses. We test this by establishing a real relay connection every few minutes.

m2m100.text: প্রতিটি চিঠি আমাদের রেলি দিয়ে যায়, তাই কেউ অন্যের ঠিকানা দেখতে পারে না. আমরা একটি বাস্তব রেলি সংযোগ স্থাপন করে প্রতি কয়েক মিনিটে এটি পরীক্ষা করি।
m2m100.back_translation: Each letter goes through our rail, so no one can see the other’s address.We check it every few minutes by placing a real rail connection.

madlad-400.text: প্রত্যেক কল আমাদের রিলের মাধ্যমে চলে, তাই কেউ অন্যের ঠিকানা দেখতে পাবে না। আমরা প্রতি কয়েক মিনিটে এটি পরীক্ষা করি একটি আসল রিলে সংযোগ স্থাপনের মাধ্যমে।
madlad-400.back_translation: Every call goes through our relay, so no one can see each other's addresses, and we check this every few minutes by connecting to a real relay.

translategemma-12b.text: আমাদের সিস্টেমের মাধ্যমে প্রতিটি কল সম্পন্ন হয়, তাই কোনো পক্ষই অন্য পক্ষের ঠিকানা দেখতে পায় না। আমরা প্রতি কয়েক মিনিট অন্তর একটি পরীক্ষামূলক সংযোগ স্থাপন করে এটি পরীক্ষা করি।
translategemma-12b.back_translation: Our system ensures that each call is routed through our servers, so neither party can see the other party's address. We test this regularly by establishing a test connection every few minutes.

translategemma-27b.text: আমাদের সমস্ত কল আমাদের রিলে সার্ভারের মাধ্যমে যায়, তাই কোনো ব্যবহারকারীই অন্য ব্যবহারকারীর ঠিকানা দেখতে পায় না। আমরা প্রতি কয়েক মিনিট অন্তর একটি আসল রিলে সংযোগ তৈরি করে এটি পরীক্ষা করি।
translategemma-27b.back_translation: All our calls are routed through our relay servers, ensuring that no user can see the address of another user. To ensure this system is working correctly, we establish a real relay connection every few minutes to test it.

translategemma-4b.text: প্রতিটি কল আমাদের মধ্যবর্তী সংযোগের মাধ্যমে যায়, তাই কোনো ব্যক্তি অন্য ব্যক্তির ঠিকানা দেখতে পায় না। আমরা নিয়মিতভাবে একটি আসল সংযোগ স্থাপন করে এটি পরীক্ষা করি।
translategemma-4b.back_translation: Each call passes through our secure connection, so no individual can see another person's address. We regularly verify this by establishing a genuine connection.

translategemma-12b.text: Wir zählen Anrufe, nicht Personen: Es werden keine Adressen, keine Identifikationsnummern und keine persönlichen Daten gespeichert; lediglich die Gesamtzahlen werden erfasst.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: We count calls, not people: No addresses, identification numbers, or personal data are stored; only the total numbers are recorded.

translategemma-27b.text: Wir zählen Anrufe, nicht Personen: es werden keine Adressen, keine Ausweise oder andere persönliche Daten gespeichert; es werden lediglich diese Gesamtzahlen erfasst.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: We record the number of calls, not the individuals making them: no addresses, identification documents, or any other personal data are stored; only these aggregate numbers are recorded.

translategemma-4b.text: Wir zählen Anrufe, nicht Personen: keine Adressen, keine Identifikationsnummern, keine Informationen über Einzelpersonen – nur diese Gesamtzahlen werden geführt.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: We track calls, not individuals: no addresses, no identification numbers, no personal information – only these overall figures are recorded.

strings.key: You choose the language you want to speak and the language you want to hear. randos pairs you with someone compatible for a short conversation, then gets out of the way.
strings.msgid: You choose the language you want to speak and the language you want to hear. randos pairs you with someone compatible for a short conversation, then gets out of the way.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Sie wählen die Sprache aus, in der Sie sprechen möchten, sowie die Sprache, in der Sie zugehört bekommen möchten. randos verbindet Sie mit einer passenden Person für ein kurzes Gespräch und zieht sich anschließend zurück.

hy-mt2.text: Sie wählen die Sprache aus, in der Sie sprechen möchten, sowie die Sprache, in der Sie zugehört bekommen möchten. randos verbindet Sie mit einer passenden Person für ein kurzes Gespräch und zieht sich anschließend zurück.
hy-mt2.back_translation: You choose the language in which you want to speak, as well as the language in which you want to be heard. Rando connects you with a suitable person for a brief conversation and then steps back.

m2m100.text: Sie wählen die Sprache, die Sie sprechen möchten, und die Sprache, die Sie hören möchten. randos Paare Sie mit jemandem, der für eine kurze Gespräche kompatibel ist, dann gehen Sie aus dem Weg.
m2m100.back_translation: You choose the language you want to speak and the language you want to hear. randos Couple you with someone that is compatible for a short conversation, then go out of the way.

madlad-400.text: Sie wählen die Sprache, die Sie sprechen möchten, und die Sprache, die Sie hören möchten. randos verbindet Sie mit jemandem, der für ein kurzes Gespräch kompatibel ist. Dann geht er aus dem Weg.
madlad-400.back_translation: You choose the language you want to speak and the language you want to listen to. randos connects you with someone who is compatible for a short conversation, then he gets out of the way.

opus-mt.text: Sie wählen die Sprache, die Sie sprechen möchten und die Sprache, die Sie hören möchten. randos paart Sie mit jemandem, der für ein kurzes Gespräch kompatibel ist, und kommt dann aus dem Weg.
opus-mt.back_translation: You choose the language you want to speak and the language you want to hear. randos Pairs you with someone who is compatible for a short conversation, and then gets out of the way.

translategemma-12b.text: Sie wählen die Sprache, die Sie sprechen möchten, und die Sprache, die Sie hören möchten. randos verbindet Sie mit einer passenden Person für ein kurzes Gespräch und greift dann nicht mehr ein.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: You choose the language you want to speak and the language you want to hear. Randos connects you with a suitable person for a brief conversation and then does not intervene further.

translategemma-27b.text: Du wählst die Sprache, die du sprechen und die Sprache, die du hören möchtest. randos verbindet dich dann mit einer passenden Person für ein kurzes Gespräch und überlässt euch danach den weiteren Verlauf.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: You choose the language you want to speak and the language you want to hear. randos then connects you with a suitable partner for a brief conversation and leaves it up to you to decide how to continue.

translategemma-4b.text: Sie wählen die Sprache aus, die Sie sprechen möchten, und die Sprache, die Sie hören möchten. randos vermittelt Ihnen einen passenden Gesprächspartner für ein kurzes Gespräch, und lässt dann die beiden selbst entscheiden.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: You choose the language you want to speak and the language you want to hear. Randos will then connect you with a suitable conversation partner for a brief conversation, and let both parties decide.

strings.key: Every call goes through our relay, so neither person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.
strings.msgid: Every call goes through our relay, so neither person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Jeder Anruf geht über unser Relais, sodass keiner der Teilnehmer die Adresse des anderen sieht. Wir prüfen das alle paar Minuten, indem wir eine echte Relaisverbindung herstellen.

hy-mt2.text: Jeder Anruf geht über unser Relais, sodass keiner der Teilnehmer die Adresse des anderen sieht. Wir prüfen das alle paar Minuten, indem wir eine echte Relaisverbindung herstellen.
hy-mt2.back_translation: Every call goes through our relay, so none of the participants sees the other’s address. We check this every few minutes by establishing a real relay connection.

m2m100.text: Jeder Anruf läuft durch unsere Relay, so dass keine Person die Adresse des anderen sieht. Wir testen es alle wenigen Minuten durch die Einrichtung einer echten Relay-Verbindung.
m2m100.back_translation: Every call runs through our relay so that no one sees the address of the other. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.

madlad-400.text: Jeder Anruf geht durch unser Relais, so dass keine Person die Adresse des anderen sieht.Wir testen es alle paar Minuten, indem wir eine echte Relais-Verbindung einrichten.
madlad-400.back_translation: Each call goes through our relay so no person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.

opus-mt.text: Jeder Anruf geht durch unser Relais, so dass keine Person die Adresse des anderen sieht. Wir testen es alle paar Minuten, indem wir eine echte Relaisverbindung einrichten.
opus-mt.back_translation: Every call goes through our relay, so no person sees the other person's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.

translategemma-12b.text: Jeder Anruf läuft über unser Relais, sodass keine der beiden beteiligten Personen die Adresse der anderen sehen kann. Wir testen dies regelmäßig, alle paar Minuten, indem wir eine echte Relaisverbindung aufbauen.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: Every call goes through our relay system, so neither of the parties involved can see the other person's address. We regularly test this, every few minutes, by establishing a real relay connection.

translategemma-27b.text: Jeder Anruf wird über unseren Server geleitet, sodass keine der beiden Parteien die Adresse des anderen einsehen kann. Um dies zu gewährleisten, führen wir alle paar Minuten einen Test durch, indem wir eine echte Verbindung über unser System herstellen.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: Every call is routed through our server, ensuring that neither party can see the other’s address. To guarantee this functionality, we run a test every few minutes by establishing a real connection through our system.

translategemma-4b.text: Jeder Anruf wird über unser System weitergeleitet, sodass keine der beiden Personen die Adresse der anderen sieht. Wir testen dies alle paar Minuten, indem wir eine echte Verbindungsübertragung einrichten.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: Each call is routed through our system, so neither party can see the other's address. We test this every few minutes by setting up a real connection.

strings.key: A conversation lasts %{call} minutes. When time is up, it continues for another %{extension} minutes only if both people choose to, up to %{max} minutes in all. You can leave at any time.
strings.msgid: A conversation lasts %{call} minutes. When time is up, it continues for another %{extension} minutes only if both people choose to, up to %{max} minutes in all. You can leave at any time.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Ein Gespräch dauert %{call} Minuten. Nach Ablauf dieser Zeit wird es nur dann um weitere %{extension} Minuten verlängert, wenn beide Gesprächspartner dies wünschen – die Gesamtdauer beträgt jedoch maximal %{max} Minuten. Sie können das Gespräch jederzeit beenden.

hy-mt2.text: Ein Gespräch dauert %{call} Minuten. Wenn die Zeit abgelaufen ist, kann es nur dann für weitere %{extension} Minuten fortgesetzt werden, wenn beide Parteien es wünschen – insgesamt maximal %{max} Minuten. Sie können jederzeit aufhören.
hy-mt2.back_translation: A call lasts %{call} minutes. When the time is up, it can only be continued for another %{extension} minutes if both parties wish – for a maximum of %{max} minutes in total. You can end it at any time.

m2m100.text: Ein Gespräch dauert %{call} Minuten.Wenn die Zeit aufgetreten ist, dauert es für weitere %{extension} Minuten nur, wenn beide Leute wählen, bis %{max} Minuten insgesamt.
m2m100.back_translation: A conversation lasts %{call} minutes.When the time has occurred, it lasts for further %{extension} minutes only if both people choose, up to %{max} minutes in total.

madlad-400.text: Ein Gespräch dauert %{call} Minuten. Wenn die Zeit abgelaufen ist, wird es für weitere %{extension} Minuten fortgesetzt, wenn beide Personen es wünschen, bis zu insgesamt %{max} Minuten.
madlad-400.back_translation: A conversation lasts %{call} minutes, when the time is up, it will continue for another %{extension} minutes if both persons wish, up to a total of %{max} minutes.

opus-mt.text: Ein Gespräch dauert %{call} Minuten. Wenn die Zeit abgelaufen ist, dauert es noch weitere %{extension} Minuten, nur wenn sich beide Menschen entscheiden, bis zu %{max} Minuten in allen. Sie können jederzeit gehen.
opus-mt.back_translation: A conversation lasts %{call} minutes. If the time has expired, it will take another %{extension} minutes, only if both people decide, up to %{max} minutes in all. You can go at any time.

translategemma-12b.text: Ein Gespräch dauert %{call} Minuten. Wenn die Zeit abgelaufen ist, kann es für weitere %{extension} Minuten fortgesetzt werden, vorausgesetzt, beide Gesprächspartner stimmen zu. Die maximale Gesprächsdauer beträgt insgesamt %{max} Minuten. Sie können das Gespräch jederzeit beenden.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: A call lasts for %{call} minutes. If the time is up, it can be extended for another %{extension} minutes, provided both parties agree. The maximum call duration is a total of %{max} minutes. You can end the call at any time.

translategemma-27b.text: Ein Gespräch dauert %{call} Minuten. Nach Ablauf dieser Zeit wird es nur dann um weitere %{extension} Minuten verlängert, wenn beide Gesprächspartner dies wünschen – die Gesamtdauer beträgt jedoch maximal %{max} Minuten. Sie können das Gespräch jederzeit beenden.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: A call lasts %{call} minutes. After this time, it will only be extended by an additional %{extension} minutes if both parties agree – however, the total call duration will not exceed %{max} minutes. You can end the call at any time.

translategemma-4b.text: Ein Gespräch dauert %{call} Minuten. Wenn die Zeit abläuft, wird es für weitere %{extension} Minuten fortgesetzt, sofern beide Personen dies wünschen, jedoch maximal %{max} Minuten insgesamt. Sie können jederzeit beenden.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: A conversation lasts for %{call} minutes. If the time is up, it will continue for an additional %{extension} minutes, provided both parties agree, but no more than a total of %{max} minutes. You can end the conversation at any time.

strings.key: Every call goes through our relay, so neither person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.
strings.msgid: Every call goes through our relay, so neither person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Todas las llamadas pasan por nuestro relé, por lo que ninguna persona ve la dirección de la otra, lo probamos cada pocos minutos estableciendo una conexión de relé real.

hy-mt2.text: Cada llamada pasa por nuestro enlace, por lo que ninguna de las personas ve la dirección de la otra. Lo probamos cada pocos minutos estableciendo una conexión de enlace real.
hy-mt2.back_translation: Each call goes through our link, so neither person sees the other’s address. We test it every few minutes by establishing a real link connection.

m2m100.text: Cada llamada pasa a través de nuestro relay, por lo que ninguna persona ve la dirección del otro.
m2m100.back_translation: Each call passes through our relay, so no one sees the direction of the other.

madlad-400.text: Todas las llamadas pasan por nuestro relé, por lo que ninguna persona ve la dirección de la otra, lo probamos cada pocos minutos estableciendo una conexión de relé real.
madlad-400.back_translation: All calls go through our relay, so no one sees the address of the other, we test it every few minutes by establishing a real relay connection.

opus-mt.text: Cada llamada pasa a través de nuestro relé, así que ninguna persona ve la dirección del otro. Lo probamos cada pocos minutos estableciendo una conexión de relé real.
opus-mt.back_translation: Every call passes through our relay, so no one sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by establishing a real relay connection.

translategemma-12b.text: Cada llamada pasa por nuestro sistema de retransmisión, por lo que ninguna de las personas ve la dirección de la otra. Lo probamos cada pocos minutos estableciendo una conexión de retransmisión real.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: Each call goes through our relay system, so neither party sees the other's address. We test this every few minutes by establishing a real relay connection.

translategemma-27b.text: Cada llamada se realiza a través de nuestro servidor intermedio, por lo que ninguna de las dos partes puede ver la dirección IP de la otra. Para garantizar su correcto funcionamiento, realizamos pruebas cada pocos minutos estableciendo una conexión real.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: Each call is routed through our intermediary server, meaning neither party can see the other’s IP address. To ensure proper operation, we perform tests every few minutes by establishing a real connection.

translategemma-4b.text: Cada llamada pasa por nuestro sistema de retransmisión, por lo que ninguna de las dos personas ve la dirección de la otra. Lo probamos cada pocos minutos, estableciendo una conexión real de retransmisión.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: Each call goes through our transmission system, so neither person can see the other's location. We test this connection every few minutes, establishing a real transmission link.

hy-mt2.text: هر تماس از طریق رله ما انجام می‌شود، بنابراین هیچ‌کدام از افراد آدرس طرف مقابل را نمی‌بینند. ما هر چند دقیقه یکبار آن را با برقراری یک اتصال رله واقعی آزمایش می‌کنیم.
hy-mt2.back_translation: Every call is made through our relay, so no one sees the recipient’s address. We test it every few minutes by establishing a real relay connection.

m2m100.back_translation: Each call passes through our contact, so no one sees the address of others.We test it every few minutes by creating a real contact connection.

madlad-400.text: هر تماسي از طريق رله‌هاي ما ميگذره، بنابراين هيچکس آدرس ديگري رو نمي‌بينه ما هر چند دقيقه با برقراري يک اتصال رله‌اي واقعي اينو آزمايش مي‌کنيم
madlad-400.back_translation: Every call goes through our relays, so no one sees the other address. We test this by making a real relay connection every few minutes.

translategemma-12b.text: هر تماس از طریق سیستم واسطه‌ای ما عبور می‌کند، بنابراین هیچ یک از طرفین، آدرس طرف مقابل را نمی‌بیند. ما این سیستم را هر چند دقیقه یک بار با ایجاد یک اتصال واسطه‌ای واقعی، تست می‌کنیم.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: Every call passes through our intermediary system, so neither party sees the other party's address. We test this system regularly, every few minutes, by creating a real intermediary connection.

translategemma-27b.text: هر مکالمه از طریق سرور واسط ما انجام می‌شود، بنابراین هیچ‌کدام از طرفین، آدرس آی‌پی (IP) طرف مقابل را نمی‌بینند. برای اطمینان، هر چند دقیقه یک‌بار، یک ارتباط واقعی را از طریق همین سرور واسط برقرار می‌کنیم و آن را تست می‌کنیم.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: Every conversation takes place through our intermediary server, meaning neither party can see the other’s IP address. To ensure this, we establish and test a real connection through the same intermediary server every few minutes.

translategemma-4b.back_translation: All communication is transmitted through our system, so neither party sees the other's address. We test this system every few minutes by establishing a real connection.

translategemma-27b.text:
Isara. / Malapit. / Tapos na. / Wakasan. / Tapusin. / Palapitin.

*(The most appropriate translation depends on the context. Here are a few options based on common uses of “close”.)*

*   **Isara** - *to close (a door, a window, a book, etc.)*
*   **Malapit** - *close (in proximity, e.g., “the store is close”)*
*   **Tapos na** - *close (as in, “the meeting is close to being finished” or “the deal is close to being finalized”)*
*   **Wakasan / Tapusin** - *to close (an event, a chapter, a project)*
*   **Palapitin** - *to bring closer (in a figurative sense, like “to close the gap”)*
translategemma-27b.back_translation:
Here’s the English translation, offering options to reflect the nuances of each Filipino term:

**Isara:** Close, shut, fasten.
**Malapit:** Close, near, nearby.
**Tapos na:** Nearly finished, almost done, close to completion.
**Wakasan / Tapusin:** Conclude, finalize, terminate, bring to a close.
**Palapitin:** Bring closer, narrow the gap, bridge the divide.

strings.key: The interface is quiet on purpose. The goal is low-pressure human presence, not performance or engagement loops.
strings.msgid: The interface is quiet on purpose. The goal is low-pressure human presence, not performance or engagement loops.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Sinasadyang tahimik ang interface. Ang layunin ay magkaroon ng presyur na mababa sa presensya ng tao, hindi ang pagpapakita ng performance o mga mekanismo para sa interaksyon.

hy-mt2.text: Sinasadyang tahimik ang interface. Ang layunin ay magkaroon ng presyur na mababa sa presensya ng tao, hindi ang pagpapakita ng performance o mga mekanismo para sa interaksyon.
hy-mt2.back_translation: The interface is intentionally quiet. The goal is to maintain a low-pressure environment in the absence of people, rather than displaying performance metrics or interaction mechanisms.

m2m100.text: Ang target ay low-pressure human presence, hindi performance o engagement loops.
m2m100.back_translation: The target is low-pressure human presence, not performance or engagement loops.

madlad-400.text: Ang interface ay tahimik sa layunin. Ang layunin ay mababang-presyon ng tao presensya, hindi pagganap o pakikipag-ugnayan loop.
madlad-400.back_translation: The interface is silent in intent. The intent is low-pressure human presence, no performance or interaction loops.

opus-mt.text: Ang interface ay tahimik sa layunin. Ang goal ay low-pressure na presensiya ng tao, hindi pagganap o mga presipitasyon ng tipanan.
opus-mt.back_translation: Interface is silent in purpose. The goal is a low-pressure human presence, not performing or engagements.

translategemma-12b.text: Ang disenyo ng interface ay sadyang simple. Ang layunin ay magkaroon ng presensya ng tao na hindi nakaka-pressure, hindi para sa pagpapaganda ng performance o para lumikha ng mga paraan para patuloy na makipag-ugnayan ang mga gumagamit.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: The interface design is intentionally simple. The goal is to create a human-like presence that is not intrusive or demanding, and not to focus on improving performance or creating ways to constantly engage users.

translategemma-27b.text: Sadyang ginawa ang disenyo ng interface upang maging simple at hindi nakakagambala. Layunin nito na magkaroon ng komportableng pakikipag-ugnayan ang mga gumagamit, hindi upang pilitin silang maging aktibo o maging abala sa paulit-ulit na gawain.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: The interface design was intentionally created to be simple and unobtrusive. Its goal is to provide users with a comfortable and seamless experience, not to force them to be constantly engaged or burdened with repetitive tasks.

translategemma-4b.text: Ang disenyo ay tahimik dahil sa layunin. Ang layunin ay magkaroon ng minimal na presensya ng tao, hindi pagganap o mga loop na nagpapasigla.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: The design is intentionally quiet, with the goal of minimizing human presence and avoiding any elements that could stimulate or encourage activity.

strings.key: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.
strings.msgid: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Nous comptons les appels, pas les gens : pas d’adresses, pas d’identifiants, rien à propos de qui que ce soit ; seuls ces totaux sont conservés.

hy-mt2.text: Nous comptons les appels, pas les personnes : pas d’adresses, pas d’identifiants, rien sur qui que ce soit ; seuls ces totaux sont conservés.
hy-mt2.back_translation: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no identifiers, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.

m2m100.text: Nous comptons les appels, pas les gens: pas d’adresses, pas d’IDs, rien de n’importe qui; seuls ces totalités sont conservées.
m2m100.back_translation: We count the calls, not the people: no addresses, no IDs, nothing of anyone; only these totals are preserved.

madlad-400.text: Nous comptons les appels, pas les gens : pas d’adresses, pas d’identifiants, rien à propos de qui que ce soit ; seuls ces totaux sont conservés.

translategemma-12b.text: Nous comptons les appels, pas les personnes : nous ne collectons aucune adresse, aucun identifiant, aucune information sur qui que ce soit ; nous ne conservons que ces totaux.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: We count the calls, not the people: we do not collect any addresses, any identifiers, or any information about anyone; we only keep these totals.

translategemma-27b.text: Nous enregistrons le nombre d’appels, et non le nombre de personnes : aucune adresse, aucune information personnelle, rien qui puisse identifier qui que ce soit ; seuls ces totaux sont conservés.

strings.key: Every call goes through our relay, so neither person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.
strings.msgid: Every call goes through our relay, so neither person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Chaque appel passe par notre système de relais, de sorte qu'aucune des deux personnes ne voit l'adresse de l'autre. Nous testons ce système toutes les quelques minutes en établissant une véritable connexion de relais.

hy-mt2.text: Chaque appel passe par notre relais, de sorte que personne ne voit l’adresse de l’autre. Nous le testons toutes les quelques minutes en établissant une connexion de relais réelle.
hy-mt2.back_translation: Every call goes through our relay, so no one sees the other party’s address. We test this every few minutes by establishing a real relay connection.

m2m100.text: Chaque appel passe par notre relay, de sorte que personne ne voit l'adresse de l'autre. Nous l'essayons tous les quelques minutes en établissant une connexion réelle.
m2m100.back_translation: Each call passes through our relay so that no one sees the other’s address. We try it every few minutes by setting up a real connection.

madlad-400.text: Chaque appel passe par notre relais, de sorte qu'aucune personne ne voit l'adresse de l'autre.Nous le testons toutes les quelques minutes en mettant en place une connexion de relais réel.
madlad-400.back_translation: Each call goes through our relay, so no one sees each other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.

opus-mt.text: Chaque appel passe par notre relais, donc personne ne voit l'adresse de l'autre. Nous le testons toutes les quelques minutes en installant une vraie connexion relais.
opus-mt.back_translation: Each call passes through our relay, so no one sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by installing a real relay connection.

translategemma-12b.text: Chaque appel passe par notre système de relais, de sorte qu'aucune des deux personnes ne voit l'adresse de l'autre. Nous testons ce système toutes les quelques minutes en établissant une véritable connexion de relais.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: Each call goes through our relay system, so neither party sees the other person's address. We test this system every few minutes by establishing a real relay connection.

translategemma-27b.text: Chaque appel passe par notre serveur de relais, de sorte qu’aucune des deux parties n’ait accès à l’adresse de l’autre. Nous vérifions son fonctionnement toutes les quelques minutes en établissant une connexion de relais réelle.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: Each call is routed through our relay server, ensuring that neither party has access to the other’s address. We verify its functionality every few minutes by establishing an actual relay connection.

translategemma-4b.text: Chaque appel passe par notre système de relais, de sorte que ni l'un ni l'autre ne voit l'adresse de l'autre. Nous vérifions régulièrement son fonctionnement en établissant une véritable connexion de relais.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: Each call goes through our relay system, so neither party can see the other's address. We regularly check its functionality by establishing a true relay connection.

strings.best_text: बातचीतें निजी होती हैं एवं उन्हें संग्रहीत नहीं किया जाता। सर्वर कॉलों का समन्वय करता है, लेकिन यह न तो कोई रिकॉर्डिंग रखता है और न ही यह जानकारी रखता है कि आपने किसके साथ बात की।

hy-mt2.text: बातचीतें निजी होती हैं एवं उन्हें संग्रहीत नहीं किया जाता। सर्वर कॉलों का समन्वय करता है, लेकिन यह न तो कोई रिकॉर्डिंग रखता है और न ही यह जानकारी रखता है कि आपने किसके साथ बात की।
hy-mt2.back_translation: Conversations are private and not stored. The server coordinates the calls, but it neither keeps any recordings nor stores information about who you talked to.

m2m100.text: वार्तालाप निजी हैं और संग्रहीत नहीं हैं. सर्वर कॉल को समन्वित करता है, लेकिन यह रिकॉर्ड नहीं रखता है या जिसके साथ आपने बात की है उसके आसपास एक इतिहास बनाता है.
m2m100.back_translation: The server coordinates the call, but it does not keep records or makes a history around the one you’ve talked with.

madlad-400.text: वार्तालाप निजी हैं और भंडारित नहीं हैं. सर्वर कॉल को समन्वित करता है, लेकिन यह रिकॉर्डिंग नहीं रखता है या आप किससे बात कर रहे हैं उसके आसपास इतिहास नहीं बनाता है.
madlad-400.back_translation: Conversations are private and are not stored. The server coordinates the calls, but it does not keep recordings or create a history around who you are talking to.

opus-mt.text: वार्तालाप निजी हैं और संग्रहीत नहीं कर रहे हैं. सर्वर निर्देशांक कॉल को, लेकिन यह याद रखने या उनके चारों ओर कोई इतिहास बनाने के लिए नहीं है जिसके साथ आप बात कर रहे हैं.
opus-mt.back_translation: The conversations are not private and stored. The server coordinate call, but it is not to remember or make no history around them with which you are talking.

translategemma-12b.text: बातचीत निजी होती है और इसे संग्रहीत नहीं किया जाता है। सर्वर कॉल को व्यवस्थित करता है, लेकिन यह रिकॉर्डिंग नहीं रखता है और यह भी नहीं ट्रैक करता है कि आपने किससे बात की।
translategemma-12b.back_translation: The conversation is private and is not stored. The server manages the calls, but it does not keep any recordings and does not track who you have spoken with.

translategemma-27b.text: बातचीतें निजी होती हैं और इन्हें सहेजा नहीं जाता। सर्वर कॉल को व्यवस्थित करता है, लेकिन यह आपकी बातचीत की कोई रिकॉर्डिंग नहीं रखता है और न ही यह इस बारे में कोई जानकारी रखता है कि आपने किससे बात की।
translategemma-27b.back_translation: Conversations are private and are not saved. The server manages the calls, but it does not retain any record of your conversations, nor does it keep any information about who you spoke with.

translategemma-4b.text: बातचीत निजी होती हैं और इन्हें संग्रहीत नहीं किया जाता। सर्वर कॉल को समन्वयित करता है, लेकिन यह कॉल के रिकॉर्ड नहीं रखता है या यह नहीं बताता कि आपने किससे बात की है।
translategemma-4b.back_translation: The conversations are private and not stored. The server coordinates the calls, but it does not keep a record of the calls or indicate who you spoke with.

strings.key: You choose the language you want to speak and the language you want to hear. randos pairs you with someone compatible for a short conversation, then gets out of the way.
strings.msgid: You choose the language you want to speak and the language you want to hear. randos pairs you with someone compatible for a short conversation, then gets out of the way.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: आप वह भाषा चुनते हैं जिसमें आप बोलना चाहते हैं, एवं वह भाषा जिसमें आप सुनना चाहते हैं। randos आपको किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति से जोड़ता है जो आपके लिए उपयुक्त हो, ताकि आप थोड़ी बातचीत कर सकें, फिर वह वहाँ से चला जाता है।

hy-mt2.text: आप वह भाषा चुनते हैं जिसमें आप बोलना चाहते हैं, एवं वह भाषा जिसमें आप सुनना चाहते हैं। randos आपको किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति से जोड़ता है जो आपके लिए उपयुक्त हो, ताकि आप थोड़ी बातचीत कर सकें, फिर वह वहाँ से चला जाता है।
hy-mt2.back_translation: You choose the language in which you want to speak, and the language in which you want to listen. Randonos connects you with someone who is suitable for you, so you can have a brief conversation, and then they leave.

m2m100.text: आप उस भाषा का चयन करते हैं जिसे आप बोलना चाहते हैं और जिस भाषा को आप सुनना चाहते हैं. randos आप किसी के साथ जोड़ते हैं जो एक संक्षिप्त वार्तालाप के लिए संगत है, फिर बाहर निकलते हैं.
m2m100.back_translation: You select the language you want to speak and the language you want to hear. randos You connect with someone that is compatible with a short conversation, then get out.

madlad-400.text: आप वह भाषा चुनते हैं जो आप बोलना चाहते हैं और वह भाषा जो आप सुनना चाहते हैं. randos आपको एक छोटी बातचीत के लिए किसी उपयुक्त व्यक्ति के साथ जोड़ता है, फिर रास्ते से बाहर हो जाता है.
madlad-400.back_translation: You choose the language you want to speak and the language you want to hear. randos connects you with a suitable person for a short conversation, then goes out of the way.

opus-mt.text: आप जिस भाषा का चयन करना चाहते हैं और जो भाषा आप सुनना चाहते हैं उसे आप चाहते हैं. randos जोड़ी आप किसी के साथ एक छोटी बातचीत के लिए अनुकूल है, तो रास्ते से बाहर हो जाता है.
opus-mt.back_translation: You want the language you want to select and the language you want to hear. randos Matching is compatible with someone, so get out of the way.

translategemma-12b.text: आप वह भाषा चुन सकते हैं जिसमें आप बात करना चाहते हैं और वह भाषा जिसमें आप सुनना चाहते हैं। "randos" आपको किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति के साथ जोड़ता है जो आपके लिए उपयुक्त हो, ताकि आप थोड़ी देर बातचीत कर सकें, और फिर यह आपको स्वतंत्र छोड़ देता है।
translategemma-12b.back_translation: You can choose the language you want to speak and the language you want to hear. "Randos" connects you with someone who is a good match for you, allowing you to have a brief conversation, and then it leaves you free to continue.

translategemma-27b.text: आप जिस भाषा में बात करना चाहते हैं और जिस भाषा में सुनना चाहते हैं, वह भाषा स्वयं चुन सकते हैं। randos आपको एक संक्षिप्त बातचीत के लिए किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति से मिलाता है जो आपकी पसंद के अनुरूप हो, और फिर वह खुद बातचीत में हस्तक्षेप नहीं करता।
translategemma-27b.back_translation: You can choose the language in which you want to speak and the language in which you want to listen. Randos connects you with someone for a brief conversation who matches your preferences, and then refrains from interfering in the conversation itself.

translategemma-4b.text: आप वह भाषा चुनते हैं जिसे आप बोलना चाहते हैं और वह भाषा जिसे आप सुनना चाहते हैं। randos आपको एक ऐसे व्यक्ति के साथ जोड़ता है जिसके साथ आप संक्षिप्त बातचीत कर सकते हैं, और फिर वह हस्तक्षेप नहीं करता।
translategemma-4b.back_translation: You choose the language you want to speak and the language you want to hear. Rando connects you with someone for a brief conversation, and then it doesn't interfere.

strings.key: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.
strings.msgid: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: हम लोगों की गिनती नहीं करते, केवल कॉल की गिनती करते हैं: कोई पता नहीं, कोई पहचान पत्र नहीं, किसी के बारे में कोई जानकारी नहीं; केवल इन कुल संख्याओं का रिकॉर्ड रखा जाता है।

hy-mt2.text: हम कॉलों की गिनती करते हैं, लोगों की नहीं: न कोई पते, न कोई आईडी, किसी के बारे में कुछ भी नहीं; केवल ये ही कुल संख्याएँ संग्रहीत की जाती हैं।
hy-mt2.back_translation: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no IDs, nothing about anyone; only these total numbers are stored.

m2m100.text: हम कॉल की गिनती करते हैं, लोगों की नहीं: कोई पता नहीं, कोई आईडी नहीं, किसी के बारे में कुछ भी नहीं; केवल ये कुल बनाए रखा जाता है।
m2m100.back_translation: We count the calls, not the people: no knowledge, no ID, nothing about anyone; only this total isined.

madlad-400.text: हम कॉल गिनते हैं, लोगों को नहीं: कोई पता नहीं, कोई आईडी नहीं, किसी के बारे में कुछ नहीं; केवल ये कुल रखे जाते हैं।
madlad-400.back_translation: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no IDs, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.

opus-mt.text: हम लोग कहते हैं, नहीं; कोई पता नहीं, कोई पहचान, किसी के बारे में कुछ नहीं; केवल ये कुल रखे जाते हैं।
opus-mt.back_translation: We say, 'No; no, no, no, no, no, nothing about anybody; only these are kept families.

translategemma-12b.text: हम लोगों की गिनती नहीं करते, केवल कॉल की गिनती करते हैं: कोई पता नहीं, कोई पहचान पत्र नहीं, किसी के बारे में कोई जानकारी नहीं; केवल इन कुल संख्याओं का रिकॉर्ड रखा जाता है।
translategemma-12b.back_translation: We don't count people; we only count calls. We have no information about individuals – no addresses, no identification, no details about who they are; we only keep records of these total numbers.

translategemma-27b.text: हम लोगों की नहीं, बल्कि कॉल की संख्या गिनते हैं: कोई भी पता, कोई भी पहचान-पत्र, या किसी के बारे में कोई भी जानकारी नहीं रखी जाती; केवल यही कुल संख्या दर्ज की जाती है।
translategemma-27b.back_translation: We keep track of the number of calls, not of the people making them: no addresses, no identification documents, or any personal information is recorded; only the total number of calls is logged.

translategemma-4b.text: हम लोगों की संख्या नहीं, बल्कि कॉल की संख्या गिनते हैं: कोई पता, कोई आईडी, या किसी के बारे में कोई जानकारी नहीं; केवल इन कुल संख्याओं को ही दर्ज किया जाता है।
translategemma-4b.back_translation: We don't count the number of people, but rather the number of calls. We don't record any address, ID, or any information about individuals; we only record these total numbers.

hy-mt2.text: लिंक भेजने वाले व्यक्ति के साथ, randos पर मौजूद किसी अन्य कॉल की तरह ही, एक-से-एक ऑडियो कॉल।

m2m100.text: एक-एक-एक ऑडियो कॉल, किसी भी अन्य पर randos की तरह, जिस व्यक्ति ने आपको लिंक भेजा है।

madlad-400.back_translation: One-on-one audio call, like someone else on randos, with the person who sent you the link.

opus-mt.text: एक से अधिक ऑडियो कॉल, किसी अन्य व्यक्ति के साथ, जो आपको लिंक भेजने के लिए भेजा है.

strings.key: The call ended because microphone access was blocked. Allow it, then look again.
strings.msgid: The call ended because microphone access was blocked. Allow it, then look again.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: कॉल इसलिए समाप्त हो गया क्योंकि माइक्रोफोन तक पहुंच अवरुद्ध थी। कृपया इसे अनुमति दें, और फिर दोबारा प्रयास करें।

hy-mt2.text: कॉल इसलिए समाप्त हो गया क्योंकि माइक्रोफोन तक पहुँच ब्लॉक हो गई थी। इसे अनुमति दें, फिर फिर से कोशिश करें।
hy-mt2.back_translation: The call ended because access to the microphone was blocked. Allow it, then try again.

m2m100.text: कॉल समाप्त हो गया क्योंकि माइक्रोफोन एक्सेस अवरुद्ध हो गया. इसे अनुमति दें, फिर फिर से देखें.
m2m100.back_translation: The call ended because the microphone access was blocked. allow it, then check again.

madlad-400.text: कॉल समाप्त हो गया क्योंकि माइक्रोफोन पहुँच अवरुद्ध था. इसे अनुमति दें, फिर फिर से देखें.
madlad-400.back_translation: The call ended because access to the microphone was blocked. Allow it, then try again.

opus-mt.text: कॉल समाप्त हो गया क्योंकि केलिब्रेट पहुँच रोक दिया गया था. इसे स्वीकारें, फिर से देखो.
opus-mt.back_translation: The call ended because Calibre's access was stopped. Accept it again.

translategemma-12b.text: कॉल इसलिए समाप्त हो गया क्योंकि माइक्रोफोन तक पहुंच अवरुद्ध थी। कृपया इसे अनुमति दें, और फिर दोबारा प्रयास करें।
translategemma-12b.back_translation: The call ended because access to the microphone was blocked. Please grant permission, and then try again.

translategemma-27b.text: कॉल इसलिए समाप्त हो गया क्योंकि माइक्रोफ़ोन की अनुमति अस्वीकृत कर दी गई थी। कृपया अनुमति दें, फिर दोबारा देखें।

strings.best_text: हर कॉल हमारे रिले के माध्यम से होती है, इसलिए कोई भी व्यक्ति दूसरे व्यक्ति का पता नहीं देख पाता। हम हर कुछ मिनटों में एक वास्तविक रिले कनेक्शन स्थापित करके इसका परीक्षण करते हैं।

hy-mt2.text: हर कॉल हमारे रिले के माध्यम से होती है, इसलिए कोई भी व्यक्ति दूसरे व्यक्ति का पता नहीं देख पाता। हम हर कुछ मिनटों में एक वास्तविक रिले कनेक्शन स्थापित करके इसका परीक्षण करते हैं।
hy-mt2.back_translation: Every call goes through our relay, so no one can see the other person’s address. We test this by establishing a real relay connection every few minutes.

m2m100.text: हर कॉल हमारे रिले के माध्यम से जाता है, इसलिए कोई भी व्यक्ति दूसरे का पता नहीं देखता. हम इसे हर कुछ मिनटों में एक वास्तविक रिले कनेक्शन स्थापित करके परीक्षण करते हैं.
m2m100.back_translation: Every call goes through our relay, so no one sees the other. we test it by installing a real relay connection every few minutes.

madlad-400.text: हर कॉल हमारे रिले के माध्यम से जाता है, इसलिए कोई भी व्यक्ति दूसरे का पता नहीं देखता है. हम इसे हर कुछ मिनटों में एक वास्तविक रिले कनेक्शन सेट करके परीक्षण करते हैं.
madlad-400.back_translation: Every call goes through our relay, so no one sees the other person's address. We test this by setting up a real relay connection every few minutes.

opus-mt.text: हर कॉल हमारे ले के माध्यम से चला जाता है, तो और कोई नहीं दूसरे का पता देखता है. हम एक असली ले कनेक्शन स्थापित करने के द्वारा हर कुछ मिनट इसे जाँच.

translategemma-12b.text: प्रत्येक कॉल हमारे माध्यम से जाता है, इसलिए कोई भी व्यक्ति दूसरे व्यक्ति का पता नहीं देख पाता। हम इसे हर कुछ मिनटों में एक वास्तविक रिले कनेक्शन स्थापित करके जांचते हैं।
translategemma-12b.back_translation: Every call goes through our system, so no one can see the other person's details. We verify this by establishing a real-time connection every few minutes.

strings.key: Counting since %{time} UTC on %{date}. This server starts fresh whenever it sleeps or is updated, so these are today's calls since then.
strings.msgid: Counting since %{time} UTC on %{date}. This server starts fresh whenever it sleeps or is updated, so these are today's calls since then.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Perhitungan dimulai sejak pukul %{time} UTC pada tanggal %{date}. Server ini selalu memulai ulang setiap kali dimatikan atau diperbarui, jadi ini adalah jumlah panggilan yang tercatat hari ini sejak saat itu.

m2m100.back_translation: This server starts fresh every time it sleeps or is updated, so this is the call of today since then.

madlad-400.text: Menghitung sejak %{time} UTC pada %{date}. Server ini di-restart setiap kali tidur atau diperbarui, jadi ini adalah panggilan hari ini sejak saat itu.
madlad-400.back_translation: Counting from %{time} UTC on %{date}. This server is restarted every time it sleeps or updates, so this is the call of the day since then.

opus-mt.text: Dihitung sejak %{time} UTC pada %{date}. Server ini mulai segar setiap kali ia tidur atau diperbarui, jadi ini adalah panggilan hari ini sejak saat itu.
opus-mt.back_translation: Counted since %{time} UTC on %{date}. This server starts fresh whenever it sleeps or is updated, so this is today's call from then on.

translategemma-12b.text: Perhitungan dimulai sejak pukul %{time} UTC pada tanggal %{date}. Server ini selalu memulai ulang setiap kali dimatikan atau diperbarui, jadi ini adalah jumlah panggilan yang tercatat hari ini sejak saat itu.

translategemma-27b.text: Pencatatan dimulai sejak pukul %{time} UTC pada tanggal %{date}. Server ini selalu dimulai dari awal setiap kali mengalami *sleep* atau diperbarui, sehingga data berikut ini menunjukkan jumlah panggilan yang terjadi sejak saat itu hingga hari ini.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: Recording began at %{time} UTC on %{date}. As the server always restarts from the beginning after being put to sleep or updated, the following data represents the total number of calls recorded from that point up to the present day.

translategemma-4b.text: Menghitung sejak pukul %{time} UTC pada tanggal %{date}. Server ini dimulai dari awal setiap kali dimatikan atau diperbarui, sehingga jumlah panggilan yang tercatat adalah panggilan sejak saat itu.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: The count starts from %{time} UTC on %{date}. This server resets each time it is turned off or updated, so the recorded number of calls is from that point onwards.

strings.key: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.
strings.msgid: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Kami hanya menghitung jumlah panggilan, bukan orangnya: tidak ada alamat, tidak ada identitas, tidak ada informasi tentang siapa pun; hanya total jumlah panggilan yang kami catat.

hy-mt2.text: Kami menghitung jumlah panggilan, bukan orangnya: tanpa alamat, tanpa ID, tanpa informasi apa pun tentang siapa pun; hanya total angka-angka inilah yang disimpan.
hy-mt2.back_translation: We count the number of calls, not the people: no addresses, no IDs, no information about anyone; only these total numbers are stored.

m2m100.text: Kami menghitung panggilan, bukan orang: tidak ada alamat, tidak ada ID, tidak ada apa-apa tentang siapa pun; hanya jumlah ini disimpan.
m2m100.back_translation: We count calls, not people: no address, no ID, no thing about anyone; just this number is stored.

madlad-400.text: Kami menghitung panggilan, bukan orang: tidak ada alamat, tidak ada id, tidak ada tentang siapa pun; hanya total ini yang disimpan.
madlad-400.back_translation: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no IDs, nothing about anyone; only this total is stored.

opus-mt.text: Kami menghitung panggilan, bukan orang: tidak ada alamat, tidak ada id, tidak ada tentang siapa pun; hanya total ini disimpan.
opus-mt.back_translation: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, no about anyone; just this total saved.

translategemma-12b.text: Kami hanya menghitung jumlah panggilan, bukan orangnya: tidak ada alamat, tidak ada identitas, tidak ada informasi tentang siapa pun; hanya total jumlah panggilan yang kami catat.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: We only count the number of calls, not the individuals: there are no addresses, no identities, no information about anyone; we only record the total number of calls.

translategemma-27b.text: Kami mencatat jumlah panggilan, bukan jumlah orang: tidak ada alamat yang dicatat, tidak ada identitas, tidak ada informasi pribadi apa pun; hanya total jumlah panggilan yang disimpan.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: We record the number of calls, not the number of people: no addresses are recorded, no identities, and no personal information of any kind; only the total number of calls is stored.

translategemma-4b.text: Kami mencatat jumlah panggilan, bukan orang-orang: tidak ada alamat, tidak ada identifikasi, atau informasi apapun tentang siapa pun; hanya total angka yang dicatat.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: We only record the number of calls, not the individuals making them: there is no address, no identification, or any information about who is calling; only the total number of calls recorded.

strings.best_text: L’interfaccia è volutamente minimalista e discreta. L’obiettivo è favorire un’interazione umana rilassata e naturale, piuttosto che puntare su prestazioni o meccanismi di coinvolgimento continuo.

strings.best_text: Le traduzioni di questo sito sono state generate automaticamente. Se noti delle imprecisioni, puoi segnalarle qui sotto premendo il pulsante “Suggerisci una modifica”: si aprirà una segnalazione su GitHub con tutti i campi precompilati, ad eccezione della tua proposta di correzione (è necessario disporre di un account GitHub). Una volta inserita la tua correzione, verrà automaticamente creata una richiesta di modifica (pull request) che, una volta approvata, verrà implementata.

hy-mt2.text: Le traduzioni di questo sito sono state realizzate da un sistema automatizzato. Se qualcosa non è corretto, trovalo di seguito e premi “Suggerisci una correzione”: si aprirà un ticket su GitHub con tutti i dati già compilati, tranne la tua correzione (è necessario avere un account GitHub). Una richiesta di merge con la tua correzione verrà aperta automaticamente e diventerà efficace una volta revisionata.
hy-mt2.back_translation: The translations on this site were done by an automated system. If something is incorrect, find it below and click “Suggest a correction”: a GitHub ticket will open with all the data already filled in, except for your correction (you need to have a GitHub account). A merge request with your correction will be created automatically and will take effect once reviewed.

hy-mt2.text: 私たちは人ではなく通話回数をカウントします。住所もIDも、個人に関する情報も一切なく、記録されるのはこの合計値だけです。
hy-mt2.back_translation: We count call volumes, not people. There are no addresses, no IDs, no personal information at all — only this total value is recorded.

m2m100.text: 呼び出しを数えるのではなく、人々を数える:住所も、IDも、誰についても何もない。

madlad-400.text: 私たちは電話を数えますが 住所やIDはありません 誰に関するものでもありません これらの合計だけが保存されます
madlad-400.back_translation: We count phone calls, but we don 't have addresses, we don 't have IDs, we don 't have anything about anyone, we just have the sum of all of these things.

translategemma-12b.text: 私たちは、個人情報を記録するのではなく、あくまでも電話の回数のみをカウントします。住所、ID、個人の情報など、一切記録しません。記録するのは、あくまでもその合計数のみです。
translategemma-12b.back_translation: We only record the number of calls made; we do not record any personal information. We do not store addresses, IDs, or any other personal details. We only record the total number of calls.

translategemma-27b.text: 通話回数を記録するだけで、個人を特定できる情報は一切記録しません。住所やIDなどの個人情報も記録せず、集計された回数のみを管理しています。
translategemma-27b.back_translation: We only record the number of calls made; no information that could be used to identify individuals is ever recorded. We do not record any personal information such as addresses or ID numbers; we only manage the aggregated call count.

translategemma-4b.text: 私たちは人数ではなく、通話回数を数えます。住所、ID、個人に関する情報は一切記録していません。ただ、これらの集計データのみを保持しています。
translategemma-4b.back_translation: We count the number of calls, not the number of people. We do not record any personal information, such as addresses or IDs. We only retain these aggregated data.

hy-mt2.text: このインターフェースは意図的に静かに設計されている。目的はプレッシャーの少ない人間的な存在感を提供することであり、パフォーマンスやエンゲージメントの循環を目指すものではない。
hy-mt2.back_translation: This interface is intentionally designed to be unobtrusive. Its purpose is to provide a low-pressure, human touch, rather than aiming for a cycle of performance and engagement.

m2m100.text: インターフェイスは目的に静かです 目標は低圧の人間の存在であり、パフォーマンスや関与の流れではありません。
m2m100.back_translation: The interface is targeted silent The goal is the low-pressure human existence, not the flow of performance or involvement.

madlad-400.text: インターフェースは意図的に静かです 目標は低圧力の人間の存在です
madlad-400.back_translation: The interface is deliberately quiet. The target is the low-pressure human presence.

translategemma-12b.text: このインターフェースは、あえてシンプルなデザインになっています。目的は、ユーザーにプレッシャーを与えず、リラックスした状態で利用してもらうことであり、パフォーマンスの向上や利用頻度の増加を促すような仕組みではありません。
translategemma-12b.back_translation: This interface is intentionally designed to be simple. The goal is to provide a user experience that is free of pressure, allowing users to relax and use the system comfortably. It is not designed to improve performance or increase usage frequency.

translategemma-27b.text: インターフェースは、意図的に控えめなデザインになっています。目的は、高いパフォーマンスや継続的な利用を促すことではなく、ユーザーがストレスを感じずに、自然に操作できるような、穏やかな存在感を提供することです。
translategemma-27b.back_translation: The interface has been intentionally designed to be understated. Rather than aiming for high performance or encouraging frequent use, the goal is to offer a gentle presence that allows users to operate it naturally and without feeling stressed.

translategemma-4b.text: インターフェースは意図的にシンプルに設計されています。目的は、パフォーマンスやエンゲージメントループではなく、控えめなユーザー体験を提供することです。
translategemma-4b.back_translation: The interface is intentionally designed to be simple. The goal is to provide a subtle and unobtrusive user experience, rather than focusing on performance or engagement loops.

strings.key: Every call goes through our relay, so neither person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.
strings.msgid: Every call goes through our relay, so neither person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.
strings.best_why: best of 6 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: すべての通話は、当社の中継システムを経由するため、どちらの相手も相手の住所を知ることができません。私たちは、実際に中継接続を確立して、数分ごとにテストを行っています。

hy-mt2.text: すべての通話は当社の中継経由で行われるため、どちらの方も相手の住所を見ることはありません。数分おきに実際の中継接続を設定することで、その機能をテストしています。
hy-mt2.back_translation: Since all calls are routed through our relay, neither party will be able to see the other’s address. We test this feature by establishing an actual relay connection every few minutes.

m2m100.text: すべての通話は私たちのリレーを通して行きますので、誰も他人の住所を見ることができません。
m2m100.back_translation: All calls go through our release, so no one can see the address of others.

madlad-400.text: すべての通話はリレーを通して行われますので、どちらの相手も相手のアドレスを見ることはありません。数分ごとに、実際のリレー接続を設定してテストします。
madlad-400.back_translation: Since all calls go through the relay, neither party sees the other party's address. Every few minutes, you set up an actual relay connection and test it.

translategemma-12b.text: すべての通話は当社のリレーを経由するため、それぞれの利用者は相手の電話番号を知ることができません。私たちは数分ごとに実際の接続テストを行い、システムが正常に機能していることを確認しています。
translategemma-12b.back_translation: All calls are routed through our relay system, which means that each user cannot know the phone number of the other party. We conduct regular connection tests every few minutes to ensure that the system is functioning correctly.

translategemma-27b.text: すべての通話は当社のサーバーを経由するため、通話相手はお互いのIPアドレスを知ることがありません。数分ごとに実際の接続を確立して、システムが正常に機能しているかを確認しています。
translategemma-27b.back_translation: All calls are routed through our servers, which means neither party in a call can see the other’s IP address. To ensure the system is functioning correctly, we establish new connections every few minutes.

translategemma-4b.text: すべての通話は、当社の中継システムを経由するため、どちらの相手も相手の住所を知ることができません。私たちは、実際に中継接続を確立して、数分ごとにテストを行っています。
translategemma-4b.back_translation: All calls are routed through our intermediary system, so neither party can see the other's address. We establish a direct connection and perform tests every few minutes.

strings.key: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.
strings.msgid: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.
strings.best_why: best of 6 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: 저희는 사람 수를 세는 것이 아니라 통화 건수를 세는 것입니다. 주소, 신분증, 개인 정보 등 어떤 정보도 수집하지 않습니다. 오직 통화 건수만 기록됩니다.

hy-mt2.text: 우리는 사람이 아닌 전화 횟수를 집계합니다. 주소도, ID도, 개인에 대한 정보도 전혀 없으며, 오직 이러한 총계만 기록됩니다.
hy-mt2.back_translation: We count the number of calls, not individuals. There are no addresses, IDs, or any information about individuals—only these totals are recorded.

m2m100.text: 우리는 전화를 계산하고 사람을 계산하지 않습니다 : 주소가 없습니다, ID가 없습니다, 아무에게도 아무것도 없습니다.
m2m100.back_translation: We count the calls and don’t count the people: there’s no address, there’s no ID, there’s nothing for anyone.

madlad-400.text: 우리는 전화를 계산, 사람이 아닙니다 : 주소 없음, ID 없음, 아무도에 대한 아무것도; 이러한 총만 유지됩니다.
madlad-400.back_translation: We count the phones, not the people: no address, no ID, nothing for no one; these numbers only remain.

translategemma-12b.text: 저희는 사람 수를 세는 것이 아니라 통화 건수를 세는 것입니다. 주소, 신분증, 개인 정보 등 어떤 정보도 수집하지 않습니다. 오직 통화 건수만 기록됩니다.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: We are not counting the number of people, but rather the number of calls. We do not collect any information, such as addresses, identification documents, or personal details. We only record the number of calls.

translategemma-27b.text: 우리는 사람 수를 세는 것이 아니라 통화 횟수를 집계합니다. 개인 정보나 식별 정보는 전혀 기록하지 않으며, 오직 총 통화 건수만 관리합니다.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: We do not count the number of people; instead, we tally the number of calls made. We collect absolutely no personal or identifying information; we only keep track of the total number of calls.

translategemma-4b.text: 우리는 사람의 정보를 기록하지 않고, 전화 건 횟수만 기록합니다. 주소, ID 등 개인 정보는 전혀 기록하지 않습니다.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: We only record the number of times someone calls, not any personal information such as their address or ID.

A pull request with your fix opens on its own, and it goes live once it's reviewed.
strings.best_why: best of 6 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: 이 웹사이트의 번역은 기계 번역을 통해 이루어졌습니다. 만약 번역에 오류가 있다면, 아래에서 해당 부분을 찾으시고 "수정 제안" 버튼을 누르세요. 그러면 GitHub에 해당 문제에 대한 보고서가 생성되며, 대부분의 정보는 자동으로 채워집니다. 단, 수정 사항은 직접 입력해야 합니다 (GitHub 계정이 필요합니다). 수정 사항을 제안하면 자동으로 "풀 리퀘스트"가 생성되며, 검토가 완료되면 해당 수정 사항이 적용됩니다.

hy-mt2.text: 이 사이트의 번역은 컴퓨터가 자동으로 처리한 것입니다. 오류가 있을 경우 아래에서 해당 부분을 찾아 “수정 제안”을 누르세요. 그러면 모든 정보가 입력된 상태의 이슈가 GitHub에 열리며, GitHub 계정이 필요합니다. 귀하가 제안한 수정 사항이 포함된 풀 리퀘스트가 자동으로 생성되고, 검토가 완료되면 즉시 적용됩니다.
hy-mt2.back_translation: The translations on this site are automatically processed by computers. If there are errors, find the relevant section below and click “Suggest a correction”. This will create an issue on GitHub with all the information filled in, and a GitHub account is required. A pull request containing your suggested corrections will be generated automatically, and it will be applied immediately once reviewed.

m2m100.back_translation: If something is wrong read, look below and press "Proposal Modification": it opens the problem on GitHub and fills everything but modifies (you need a GitHub account).

madlad-400.text: 이 사이트의 번역은 기계로 이루어졌습니다. 뭔가 잘못 읽는다면, 아래를 찾아보고 “수정 제안”을 누르십시오: 이것은 GitHub에 문제를 열고 모든 것을 채우지만 수정합니다 (GitHub 계정이 필요합니다). 수정 요청이 자체적으로 열리며 검토되면 라이브가됩니다.
madlad-400.back_translation: The translation of this site has been done by a machine. If you read something wrong, look below and click "Suggest a correction": This will open an issue on GitHub and fill in everything but the correction (requires a GitHub account).

translategemma-12b.text: 이 웹사이트의 번역은 기계 번역을 통해 이루어졌습니다. 만약 번역에 오류가 있다면, 아래에서 해당 부분을 찾으시고 "수정 제안" 버튼을 누르세요. 그러면 GitHub에 해당 문제에 대한 보고서가 생성되며, 대부분의 정보는 자동으로 채워집니다. 단, 수정 사항은 직접 입력해야 합니다 (GitHub 계정이 필요합니다). 수정 사항을 제안하면 자동으로 "풀 리퀘스트"가 생성되며, 검토가 완료되면 해당 수정 사항이 적용됩니다.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: This website's translation is provided through machine translation. If you find any errors in the translation, please locate the relevant section below and click the "Suggest Edit" button. This will create a report on GitHub detailing the issue, and most of the information will be automatically filled in. However, you will need to manually enter the suggested corrections (a GitHub account is required). When you propose a correction, a "pull request" will be automatically created, and once it is reviewed, the correction will be applied.

translategemma-27b.text: 이 사이트의 번역은 기계 번역으로 이루어졌습니다. 어색하거나 부자연스러운 부분이 있다면 아래에서 해당 부분을 찾아 “수정 제안” 버튼을 눌러주세요. 그러면 GitHub에 수정 내용만 입력할 수 있는 상태로 이슈가 자동으로 생성됩니다(GitHub 계정이 필요합니다). 수정 내용을 제출하면 풀 리퀘스트가 자동으로 생성되고, 검토가 완료되면 해당 수정 사항이 적용됩니다.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: The translation on this site is generated using machine translation. If you find any awkward or unnatural phrasing, please select the relevant section and click the “Suggest an Edit” button. This will automatically create an issue on GitHub, allowing you to submit only the suggested changes (a GitHub account is required). Once submitted, a pull request will be automatically generated, and the changes will be applied after review.

translategemma-4b.text: 이 웹사이트의 번역은 기계 번역으로 이루어졌습니다. 내용이 어색하게 느껴진 경우, 아래에 있는 "수정 제안" 버튼을 클릭하여 GitHub에 문제를 제기할 수 있습니다. GitHub 계정이 필요하며, 모든 정보가 미리 채워진 상태로 문제 제기가 가능합니다. 수정 사항이 확인되면, 자동으로 pull request가 생성되어 게시됩니다.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: This website's translation was performed using machine translation. If you find the content to be awkward, you can click the "Suggest Edits" button below to report the issue on GitHub. A GitHub account is required, and you can submit the issue with all information pre-filled. Once the edits are confirmed, a pull request will be automatically created and published.

strings.best_text: 대화는 비공개이며 저장되지 않습니다. 서버는 통화를 조율하지만, 녹음본을 보관하거나 누구와 통화했는지에 대한 기록을 만들지 않습니다.

hy-mt2.text: 대화는 비공개이며 저장되지 않습니다. 서버는 통화를 조율하지만, 녹음본을 보관하거나 누구와 통화했는지에 대한 기록을 만들지 않습니다.

m2m100.text: 대화는 개인적이며 저장되지 않습니다. 서버는 전화를 조정하지만 기록을 유지하거나 당신이 이야기 한 사람 주위에 역사를 구축하지 않습니다.
m2m100.back_translation: The conversation is personal and not stored. the server adjusts the call but does not keep records or build history around the person you talked about.

madlad-400.back_translation: Conversations are private and are not stored. The server moderates the call, but does not keep a recording or record of who you've been talking to.

translategemma-12b.text: 대화 내용은 비공개이며 저장되지 않습니다. 서버는 통화를 연결하는 역할을 하지만, 통화 녹음이나 대화 상대방에 대한 기록을 저장하지 않습니다.

translategemma-27b.back_translation: The content of your conversations is private and is not saved. Our servers simply facilitate the connection between users; no record of the conversation itself, or of who you spoke with, is ever stored.

translategemma-4b.text: 대화 내용은 개인 정보이며 저장되지 않습니다. 서버는 통화를 관리하지만, 통화 내용을 녹음하거나 누구와 통화했는지 기록하는 기능은 없습니다.

strings.key: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.
strings.msgid: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Мы считаем количество звонков, а не людей: мы не собираем никаких адресов, идентификаторов, никакой информации о ком-либо; мы фиксируем только общие итоги.

hy-mt2.text: Мы считаем звонки, а не людей: нет адресов, нет идентификаторов, ничего о конкретных людях; сохраняются только эти общие показатели.
hy-mt2.back_translation: We count calls, not people: there are no addresses, no identifiers, nothing about specific individuals; only these general metrics are kept.

m2m100.text: Мы рассчитываем звонки, а не людей: нет адресов, нет идентификаторов, ни о ком-либо ничего; только эти тотали сохраняются.
m2m100.back_translation: We calculate calls, not people: there are no addresses, no identifiers, nothing about anyone; only these totals are preserved.

madlad-400.text: Мы считаем звонки, а не людей: никаких адресов, никаких идентификаторов, ничего о ком-либо; только эти суммы сохраняются.
madlad-400.back_translation: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no IDs, nothing about anyone; only these amounts are kept.

opus-mt.text: Мы считаем звонки, а не людей: нет адресов, нет документов, ничего о ком-либо; только эти итоговые данные сохраняются.
opus-mt.back_translation: We count the calls, not the people: no addresses, no documents, nothing about anyone; only these totals are retained.

translategemma-12b.text: Мы считаем количество звонков, а не людей: мы не собираем никаких адресов, идентификаторов, никакой информации о ком-либо; мы фиксируем только общие итоги.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: We count the number of calls, not the number of people. We don't collect any addresses, identifiers, or any information about individuals; we only record the overall totals.

strings.key: Every call goes through our relay, so neither person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.
strings.msgid: Every call goes through our relay, so neither person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Каждый звонок проходит через наш ретранслятор, поэтому ни один из участников не видит адреса другого. Мы проверяем это каждые несколько минут, устанавливая реальное соединение через ретранслятор.

hy-mt2.text: Каждый звонок проходит через наш ретранслятор, поэтому ни один из участников не видит адреса другого. Мы проверяем это каждые несколько минут, устанавливая реальное соединение через ретранслятор.
hy-mt2.back_translation: Every call goes through our relay, so none of the participants can see the other’s address. We check this every few minutes by establishing a real connection through the relay.

m2m100.text: Каждый звонок проходит через наш релей, поэтому ни один человек не видит адрес другого.Мы тестируем его каждые несколько минут, устанавливая реальную релейную связь.
m2m100.back_translation: Each call passes through our relay, so no one sees the other address.We test it every few minutes, setting up a real relay connection.

madlad-400.text: Каждый вызов проходит через наш релей, так что ни один человек не видит адрес другого. Мы тестируем его каждые несколько минут, устанавливая реальное релейное соединение.
madlad-400.back_translation: Every call goes through our relay so no one sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by establishing a real relay connection.

opus-mt.text: Каждый звонок проходит через наш реле, так что никто не видит адрес другого, мы проверяем его каждые несколько минут, установим реальное соединение.
opus-mt.back_translation: Every call goes through our relay, so no one sees the address of the other, we check it every few minutes, we establish a real connection.

translategemma-12b.text: Каждый звонок проходит через нашу систему ретрансляции, поэтому ни один из собеседников не видит адрес другого. Мы регулярно проверяем ее, устанавливая реальное соединение через ретранслятор.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: Every call goes through our relay system, so neither party can see the other's address. We regularly check this system by establishing a real connection through the relay.

translategemma-27b.text: Каждый звонок проходит через наш сервер-посредник, поэтому ни один из абонентов не видит адрес другого. Мы проверяем работоспособность системы каждые несколько минут, устанавливая реальное соединение через этот сервер.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: Each call is routed through our intermediary server, ensuring that neither party can see the other’s direct address. We verify the system’s functionality every few minutes by establishing a real connection through this server.

translategemma-4b.text: Каждый звонок проходит через нашу систему, поэтому ни один из участников не видит адрес другого. Мы регулярно проверяем это, устанавливая реальное соединение.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: Each call passes through our system, so none of the participants can see the other person's address. We regularly verify this by establishing a real connection.

translategemma-27b.text:
Ghairi. / Batili. / Ghairi kutekelezwa. / Kataliwa.

*(The most appropriate translation depends on the context. “Ghairi” is a general cancellation. “Batili” implies something is void or invalid. “Ghairi kutekelezwa” means “not to be carried out/executed” and “Kataliwa” means “rejected/denied”.)*
translategemma-27b.back_translation:
Here are a few options, depending on the intended nuance:

**Option 1 (General/Neutral):**

Cancelled. / Void. / Not to be executed. / Rejected.

**Option 2 (More formal/legal context):**

Invalid. / Null and void. / Not to be implemented. / Denied.

**Option 3 (Concise):**

Voided. / Cancelled. / Rejected.

translategemma-12b.text: Tafsiri za tovuti hii zimetengenezwa kwa kutumia programu. Ikiwa kuna kitu ambacho hakielezeki vizuri, tafuta sehemu hiyo hapa chini na ubofye "Pendekeza marekebisho": hii itafungua ombi kwenye GitHub ambapo kila kitu kimeandikwa isipokuwa marekebisho yako (unahitaji akaunti ya GitHub). translategemma-27b.back_translation: The translations on this website were generated by a computer. If you find any part that is unclear or inaccurate, please search for it below and click “Suggest an edit”: this will open a request on GitHub, where all the information will already be filled in except for your suggested changes (you will need a GitHub account). Once your changes are submitted, a new request will be initiated and will be published after review by experts.

translategemma-4b.text: الترجمات kwenye tovuti hii zimefanywa na mashine. Ombi la "pull" lenye suluhisho lako litafunguliwa, na litakuwa la kazi mara tu litaidhinishwa.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: The translations on this website are machine-generated. If you find anything that doesn't make sense, please report it here and click "Provide solution": this will open the issue on GitHub, and everything will be written there, except for your solution (you will need an account on GitHub). A "pull" request with your solution will be opened, and it will be ready for review as soon as it is approved.

strings.key: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.
strings.msgid: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.
strings.best_why: best of 5 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Sisi tunahesabu idadi ya simu zilizopigwa, si watu; hatutunzi taarifa za anwani, vitambulisho, au taarifa yoyote kuhusu mtu yeyote; tunahifadhi tu takwimu hizo za jumla.

m2m100.text: Sisi kuhitimisha majibu, si watu: hakuna majibu, hakuna ids, hakuna kitu kuhusu mtu yeyote; tu jumla hizi zinahifadhiwa.
m2m100.back_translation: We conclude answers, not people: no answers, no ids, nothing about anyone; just these generals are stored.

madlad-400.text: Sisi kuhesabu simu, si watu: hakuna anwani, hakuna ids, hakuna kitu kuhusu mtu yeyote; tu jumla hizi ni kuhifadhiwa.
madlad-400.back_translation: We count phones, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are stored.

translategemma-12b.text: Sisi tunarekodi idadi ya simu, si watu: hatutakuwa na anwani zozote, nambari za utambulisho, wala taarifa zozote kuhusu mtu yeyote; tunahifadhi tu idadi jumla.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: We record the number of calls, not people: we will not have any addresses, identification numbers, or any information about any individual; we only store the total number of calls.

translategemma-27b.text: Sisi tunahesabu idadi ya simu zilizopigwa, si watu; hatutunzi taarifa za anwani, vitambulisho, au taarifa yoyote kuhusu mtu yeyote; tunahifadhi tu takwimu hizo za jumla.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: We only count the number of calls made, not the people making them; we do not keep records of contact details, identification, or any other personal information; we only store these aggregate statistics.

translategemma-4b.text: Tunachangulia simu, si watu: hakuna anwani, hakuna namba za utambuzi, wala taarifa yoyote kuhusu mtu; tu idadi hizi zinaendeleka.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: We are focusing on the numbers, not the people: there are no addresses, no identification numbers, and no information about the individuals; only these numbers are being tracked.
