strings.key: Every call goes through our relay, so neither person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.
strings.msgid: Every call goes through our relay, so neither person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.
strings.best_why: best of 5 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Kila simu inapitishwa kupitia mfumo wetu, hivyo hakuna mtu anayeweza kuona anwani ya mtu mwingine. Hili tunalihakikisha kwa kufanya majaribio kila baada ya dakika chache kwa kuunda muunganisho halisi wa simu.

m2m100.text: Kila simu huenda kwa njia ya relay yetu, hivyo hakuna mtu anayeona anwani ya mtu mwingine. Tunatazama kila dakika kwa kuanzisha uhusiano wa relay halisi.
m2m100.back_translation: Every phone goes through our relay, so no one sees the address of someone else. We look at every minute by setting up a real relay connection.

madlad-400.text: Kila wito hupita kupitia relay yetu, hivyo wala mtu anaona anwani nyingine. Sisi mtihani kila dakika chache kwa kuanzisha uhusiano relay halisi.
madlad-400.back_translation: Every call passes through our relay, so no one sees the other address. We test every few minutes to establish a real relay connection.

translategemma-12b.text: Kila simu hupitia mfumo wetu wa kusambaza, hivyo hakuna mtu yeyote anayeona anwani ya mtu mwingine. Tunajaribu mfumo huu kila dakika chache kwa kuunganisha moja kwa moja.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: Every call goes through our distribution system, so no one can see another person's contact information. We test this system every few minutes by making a direct connection.

translategemma-27b.text: Kila simu inapitishwa kupitia mfumo wetu, hivyo hakuna mtu anayeweza kuona anwani ya mtu mwingine. Hili tunalihakikisha kwa kufanya majaribio kila baada ya dakika chache kwa kuunda muunganisho halisi wa simu.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: Each call is routed through our system, ensuring that no one can see another person’s phone number. We guarantee this by running tests every few minutes, creating actual phone connections to verify the system.

translategemma-4b.text: Kila simu hutumia mtandao wetu, hivyo mtu mmoja hawezi kuona anwani ya mtu mwingine. Tunachukua hatua za utumiaji kila dakika chache kwa kuweka muunganisho halisi.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: Each call uses our network, so one person cannot see another person's address. We take measures to ensure a secure connection every few minutes.

strings.key: There are no accounts, profiles, contacts, followers, feeds, streaks, scores, or permanent social graph. randos is closer to conversational infrastructure than social media.
strings.msgid: There are no accounts, profiles, contacts, followers, feeds, streaks, scores, or permanent social graph. randos is closer to conversational infrastructure than social media.
strings.best_why: best of 5 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Hakuna akaunti, wasifu, orodha ya marafiki, wafuasi, habari za matukio, alama, au muundo wa uhusiano wa kijamii unaodumu. randos ni zaidi kama miundombinu ya mawasiliano ya kawaida kuliko mitandao ya kijamii.

m2m100.text: Hakuna akaunti, profili, mawasiliano, wafuasi, vifaa, vifaa, mafanikio, au graph ya kijamii ya daima. randos ni karibu na vifaa vya mazungumzo kuliko mitandao ya kijamii.
m2m100.back_translation: No accounts, profiles, communications, followers, equipment, equipment, success, or social graph are always. randos is closer to chat equipment than social networks.

madlad-400.text: Hakuna akaunti, wasifu, mawasiliano, wafuasi, malisho, streaks, alama, au kudumu kijamii graph. randos ni karibu na miundombinu ya mazungumzo kuliko vyombo vya habari kijamii.
madlad-400.back_translation: There are no accounts, profiles, contacts, followers, feeds, streaks, bookmarks, or a permanent social graph. randos is closer to a conversational infrastructure than social media.

translategemma-12b.text: Hakuna akaunti, wasifu, anwani, wafuasi, matoleo ya habari, rekodi za muda, alama, au mtandao wa kijamii unaodumu. "randos" inakaribia zaidi mfumo wa mawasiliano kuliko tovuti za mitandao ya kijamii.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: There are no accounts, profiles, addresses, followers, news feeds, timelines, likes, or social networks involved. "Randos" is closer to a communication system than a social media website.

translategemma-27b.text: Hakuna akaunti, wasifu, orodha ya marafiki, wafuasi, habari za matukio, alama, au muundo wa uhusiano wa kijamii unaodumu. randos ni zaidi kama miundombinu ya mawasiliano ya kawaida kuliko mitandao ya kijamii.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: There are no accounts, profiles, friend lists, followers, event feeds, badges, or persistent social relationship structures. Randos functions more like a basic communication infrastructure than a social network.

translategemma-4b.text: Hapana, hakuna akaunti, majina, mawasiliano, watafuatilia, habari, rekodi, alama, au mwangalii wa kijamii. randos ni karibu na mfumo wa ushirikiano kuliko mitandao ya kijamii.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: No, there are no accounts, names, contact information, followers, news, records, ratings, or social media profiles. Randos is closer to a collaborative platform than social media networks.

strings.best_text: Unaweza kuchagua lugha ambayo ungependa kuzungumza na lugha ambayo ungependa kusikiliza. randos hukufanya kuungana na mtu anayefaa kwa mazungumzo fupi, na kisha huondoka.

m2m100.text: Unachagua lugha ambayo unataka kuzungumza na lugha ambayo unataka kusikia. randos unachagua na mtu aliyounganishwa kwa mazungumzo ya muda mfupi, kisha unapata njia.

madlad-400.text: Unaweza kuchagua lugha unataka kuzungumza na lugha unataka kusikia. randos jozi wewe na mtu sambamba kwa ajili ya mazungumzo mafupi, kisha anapata nje ya njia.

translategemma-12b.text: Unachagua lugha unayotaka kuzungumza na lugha unayotaka kusikia. Programu ya "randos" hukupatia mshirika ambaye anafaa kwa mazungumzo mafupi, kisha inakwenda.

translategemma-27b.text: Unaweza kuchagua lugha unayotaka kuongea nayo na lugha unayotaka kusikia. “randos” huwashirikisha watu wawili wanaolingana kwa mazungumzo mafupi, kisha huacha kila mtu aendelee kivyake.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: You can choose the language you want to speak and the language you want to hear. “Randos” pairs two people for a brief conversation, then allows each person to continue on their own.

translategemma-4b.text: Unaweza kuchagua lugha ambayo ungependa kuzungumza na lugha ambayo ungependa kusikiliza. randos hukufanya kuungana na mtu anayefaa kwa mazungumzo fupi, na kisha huondoka.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: You can choose the language you want to speak and the language you want to listen to. Rando allows you to connect with someone who is a good match for short conversations, and then they move on.

strings.best_text: Tafsiri za tovuti hii zimetengenezwa kwa kutumia programu, na bado hazijapitia ukaguzi wa watu. Ikiwa kuna kitu ambacho hakisomeki vizuri katika lugha yako, tafadhali saidia kurekebisha: tafuta maandishi, andika jinsi kinapaswa kusomwa, na sisi tutashughulikia mambo mengine.

m2m100.text: Maonyesho ya tovuti hii yalitengenezwa kwa kompyuta na bado haikamatwa na watu. Ikiwa kitu kinachorushwa katika lugha yako, tafadhali msaada: kutafuta maandishi, kuandika jinsi ya kusoma, na tutakuwa na mambo mengine.
m2m100.back_translation: The exhibition of this site is designed for a computer and still not captured by people. If something is broken in your language, please help: search for text, write how to read, and we will have other things.

madlad-400.text: Tafsiri za tovuti hii zilifanywa na mashine na hazijapitiwa na watu bado. Kama kuna kitu kinasoma vibaya katika lugha yako, tafadhali saidia kurekebisha: pata maandishi, andika jinsi inapaswa kusoma, na sisi tutafanya mapumziko.
madlad-400.back_translation: Translations of this site have been done by machines and have not been reviewed by humans yet. If something reads wrong in your language, please help correct it: find the text, write how it should read, and we will do the rest.

translategemma-12b.text: Tafsiri za tovuti hii zimetengenezwa kwa kutumia programu, na bado hazijapitia ukaguzi wa watu. translategemma-12b.back_translation: The translations on this website are generated by a computer program and have not yet been reviewed by a human. If you find anything that is not translated correctly in your language, please help us improve it: find the text, write down how it should be translated, and we will take care of the rest.

translategemma-27b.text: Tafsiri za tovuti hii zilitolewa na kompyuta na bado hazijachunguzwa na watu. Ikiwa kuna sehemu yoyote ambayo haielezeki vizuri katika lugha yako, tafadhali saidia kuirekebisha: tafuta maandishi hayo, andika jinsi yanapaswa kuonekana, na sisi tutafanya marekebisho yote.

If you notice any parts that are unclear or inaccurate in your language, please help us improve them: locate the text, suggest the correct wording, and we will make the necessary corrections.

translategemma-4b.text: Taarifa za tovuti hizi zimeundwa na mashine, na hazijotafutwa na watu. Ikiwa kuna kitu ambacho haelewe katika lugha yako, tafadhali usaidie kurekebisha: tafuta maandishi, andika jinsi inapaswa kuandikwa, na tutaendesha sehemu iliyobaki.

strings.key: A conversation lasts %{call} minutes. When time is up, it continues for another %{extension} minutes only if both people choose to, up to %{max} minutes in all. You can leave at any time.
strings.msgid: A conversation lasts %{call} minutes. When time is up, it continues for another %{extension} minutes only if both people choose to, up to %{max} minutes in all. You can leave at any time.
strings.best_why: best of 5 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Mazungumzo yanaweza kudumu kwa dakika %{call}. Wakati huu ukiisha, yanaweza kuendelea kwa dakika %{extension} nyingine, lakini tu iwapo wote wawili wataamua hivyo, na kwa jumla si zaidi ya dakika %{max}. Unaweza kuacha mazungumzo wakati wowote.

m2m100.text: Mkutano unaendelea kwa dakika %{call}. Wakati muda ni juu, inaendelea kwa dakika nyingine %{extension} tu kama watu wawili wanataka, hadi dakika %{max} kwa ujumla. Unaweza kwenda wakati wowote.
m2m100.back_translation: The meeting lasts for minutes %{call}. When the time is high, it lasts for other minutes %{extension} just as two people want, up to minutes %{max} in general. You can go at any time.

madlad-400.text: Mazungumzo huchukua dakika %{call}. Wakati muda umekwisha, itaendelea kwa dakika nyingine %{extension} tu kama watu wote wawili watachagua, hadi dakika %{max} kwa jumla. Unaweza kuondoka wakati wowote.
madlad-400.back_translation: The conversation lasts %{call} minutes. When the time is up, it will continue for another %{extension} minute only if both people choose, up to %{max} minutes in total. You can leave at any time.

translategemma-12b.text: Mazungumzo hudumu kwa dakika %{call}. Wakati unapita, yanaendelea kwa dakika nyingine %{extension} tu, ikiwa watu wote wawili wanataka, na kwa muda usiozidi dakika %{max} kwa jumla. Unaweza kuacha mazungumzo wakati wowote.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: The conversation lasts for {call} minutes. If both parties wish to continue, it can be extended by another {extension} minutes, for a total duration not exceeding {max} minutes. You can end the conversation at any time.

translategemma-27b.text: Mazungumzo yanaweza kudumu kwa dakika %{call}. Wakati huu ukiisha, yanaweza kuendelea kwa dakika %{extension} nyingine, lakini tu iwapo wote wawili wataamua hivyo, na kwa jumla si zaidi ya dakika %{max}. Unaweza kuacha mazungumzo wakati wowote.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: The conversation can last for %{call} minutes. Once this time is up, it can be extended for an additional %{extension} minutes, but only if both parties agree, and the total duration will not exceed %{max} minutes. You can end the conversation at any time.

translategemma-4b.text: Mazungumzo huchukua dakika %{call}. Baada ya muda, itazidi kwa dakika %{extension} zaidi, ikiwa watu wote wanachagua, hadi dakika %{max} kwa jumla. Unaweza kuondoka wakati wowote.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: The conversation lasts for approximately %{call} minutes. After that, it will continue for an additional %{extension} minutes, up to a total of %{max} minutes, if all participants agree. You can leave at any time.

strings.msgid: The interface is quiet on purpose. The goal is low-pressure human presence, not performance or engagement loops.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Arayüz, kasıtlı olarak sade ve sessiz tasarlanmıştır. Amaç, yüksek performans veya etkileşim döngüleri yaratmak değil, kullanıcıların rahat ve huzurlu bir deneyim yaşamalarını sağlamaktır.

hy-mt2.text: Arayüz kasıtlı olarak sade tutulmuştur. Amaç, performans veya etkileşim döngüleri değil, düşük baskılı bir insan varlığıdır.
hy-mt2.back_translation: The interface has been intentionally kept simple. The goal is a low-pressure human presence, not performance or interaction loops.

m2m100.text: Hedef düşük basınçlı insan varlığı, performans veya engelleme kayıpları değil.
m2m100.back_translation: The target is not low-pressure human existence, performance or impedance loss.

madlad-400.text: Arayüz kasıtlı olarak sessiz, amaç düşük basınçlı insan varlığı, performans veya bağlantı döngüleri değil.
madlad-400.back_translation: The interface is deliberately quiet, not intended for low-pressure human presence, performance or connection loops.

opus-mt.text: Arayüz bilerek sessizdir. Amaç, performans veya nişan döngüleri değil, düşük basınçlı insan varlığıdır.
opus-mt.back_translation: The interface is purposely silent, not performance or engagement cycles, but a low-pressure human presence.

translategemma-12b.text: Arayüz, kasıtlı olarak sade ve sessiz tasarlanmıştır. Amaç, yüksek performans veya etkileşim döngüleri yaratmak değil, kullanıcıların rahat ve huzurlu bir deneyim yaşamalarını sağlamaktır.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: The interface is intentionally designed to be simple and unobtrusive. The goal is not to create high performance or complex interactions, but rather to ensure that users have a comfortable and peaceful experience.

translategemma-27b.text: Arayüz, kasıtlı olarak sade ve minimal tutuldu. Amaç, kullanıcıyı sürekli bir performans veya etkileşim döngüsüne sokmak değil, rahat ve doğal bir etkileşim sağlamaktır.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: The interface was intentionally kept simple and minimal. The goal wasn’t to constantly engage the user in a cycle of performance or interaction, but rather to provide a comfortable and natural experience.

translategemma-4b.text: Arayüz, bilinçli olarak sade ve minimalist bir tasarıma sahip. Amaç, kullanıcı deneyimini olumsuz etkilemeden, düşük yoğunluklu bir etkileşim sağlamaktır, performans veya etkileşim döngülerine odaklanmak değil.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: The interface is intentionally simple and minimalist in design. The goal is to provide a low-intensity interaction that doesn't negatively impact the user experience, rather than focusing on performance or interaction cycles.

strings.key: Every call goes through our relay, so neither person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.
strings.msgid: Every call goes through our relay, so neither person sees the other's address. We test it every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Her arama bizim iletim sistemimizden geçer, bu yüzden taraflardan hiçbiri diğerinin adresini göremez. Bunu her birkaç dakikada bir gerçek bir iletim bağlantısı kurarak test ederiz.

hy-mt2.text: Her arama bizim iletim sistemimizden geçer, bu yüzden taraflardan hiçbiri diğerinin adresini göremez. Bunu her birkaç dakikada bir gerçek bir iletim bağlantısı kurarak test ederiz.
hy-mt2.back_translation: Every call goes through our transmission system, so neither party can see the other’s address. We test this by establishing a real transmission connection every few minutes.

m2m100.text: Her çağrı bizim relay aracılığıyla gidiyor, bu yüzden hiç kimse başkasının adresini görmüyor. biz gerçek bir relay bağlantısı kurarak her birkaç dakika test.
m2m100.back_translation: Every call goes through our relay, so no one sees someone else’s address. we test every few minutes by setting up a real relay connection.

madlad-400.text: Her çağrı bizim relay'dan geçiyor, böylece iki kişi de birbirlerinin adresini göremiyor. her birkaç dakikada bir gerçek relay bağlantısı kurarak test ediyoruz.
madlad-400.back_translation: Every call goes through our relay, so no two people can see each other's address. We test it by establishing a real relay connection every few minutes.

opus-mt.text: Her arama rölemizden geçer, bu yüzden kimse diğerinin adresini görmez. Gerçek bir röle bağlantısı kurarak birkaç dakikada bir test ederiz.
opus-mt.back_translation: Every call passes through our relay, so no one sees the other's address, so we test it every few minutes by connecting it to a real relay.

translategemma-12b.text: Her arama, sistemimizdeki bir geçiş noktası üzerinden gerçekleşir, bu nedenle hiçbir tarafın diğerinin adresini görmesi mümkün değildir. Bunu, düzenli aralıklarla gerçek bir geçiş bağlantısı kurarak birkaç dakikada bir test ediyoruz.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: Every connection is made through a relay point in our system, so neither party can see the other's address. We test this regularly by establishing a real connection through the relay point every few minutes.

translategemma-27b.text: Her arama, bizim aracılığımızdan geçtiği için, taraflardan hiçbiri diğerinin adresini görmez. Bu sistemi birkaç dakikada bir gerçek bir bağlantı kurarak test ediyoruz.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: Since all communication goes through our platform, neither party sees the other’s address. We test this system by establishing a genuine connection every few minutes.

translategemma-4b.text: Her görüşme, bizim aracılığıyla yönlendirildiği için, iki tarafın birbirlerinin adreslerini görmesi mümkün değildir. Bunu, gerçek bir iletişim hattı kurarak birkaç dakika arayla test ediyoruz.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: Because all communications are conducted through us, it is impossible for either party to see the other's address. We test this by establishing a real communication line and checking it every few minutes.

m2m100.back_translation: We count the calls, we don’t count the people: there’s no address, no identity, nothing about anyone; only these summals are saved.

madlad-400.text: Aramaları sayıyoruz, insanları değil: adres yok, kimlik yok, kimse hakkında hiçbir şey yok; sadece bu toplamlar tutulur.
madlad-400.back_translation: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no IDs, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.

opus-mt.text: Çağrıları sayıyoruz, insanları değil: adres yok, kimlik yok, kimse hakkında hiçbir şey yok; sadece bu toplamlar tutuluyor.
opus-mt.back_translation: We're counting calls, not people: no addresses, no IDs, nothing about anyone; just these sums are being held.

translategemma-12b.text: Biz, kişileri değil, aramaları sayıyoruz: herhangi bir adres, kimlik bilgisi veya kişisel veri kaydetmiyoruz; sadece toplam çağrı sayıları tutuluyor.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: We count calls, not individuals: we do not store any addresses, personal information, or personal data; we only keep track of the total number of calls.

translategemma-27b.back_translation: We only keep track of the number of calls, not the callers themselves: we do not store any addresses, identification information, or personal data; only the total numbers are recorded.

translategemma-4b.text: Biz çağrıları sayıyoruz, kişileri değil: adres, kimlik numarası veya herhangi bir kişiyle ilgili bilgi tutmuyoruz; sadece bu toplamlar kaydediliyor.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: We track calls, not individuals: we do not store any information related to a person, such as addresses or identification numbers; we only record these aggregate figures.

strings.best_text: اس کا مقصد %{crosstalk}، لسانی تبادلہ، سننے کی مشق، اور عام، غیر رسمی گفتگو کو فروغ دینا ہے، جس میں لوگوں پر سختی سے کوئی خاص انداز یا شناخت مسلط نہ کی جائے۔

hy-mt2.text: یہ %{crosstalk}، زبان کے تبادلے، سننے کی مشق، اور عام غیر رسمی گفتگو کے لیے ہے، بغیر لوگوں کو کسی سخت قالب یا زمرے میں محدود کیے۔
hy-mt2.back_translation: This is for %{crosstalk}, language exchange, listening practice, and casual conversation, without restricting people to any strict format or category.

m2m100.text: یہ %{crosstalk}، زبان کا تبادلہ، سننے کی عمل، اور عام تصادفی بات چیت کے بغیر لوگوں کو سخت موڈ یا ٹیبل میں مجبور کرنے کے لئے ہے.
m2m100.back_translation: It is %{crosstalk} to force people to hard form or table without language exchange, listening process, and general random word chat.

madlad-400.text: یہ %{crosstalk} ، زبان کے تبادلے ، سننے کی مشق ، اور عام غیر رسمی گفتگو کے لئے ہے ، بغیر لوگوں کو سخت موڈز یا لیبلز میں مجبور کرنے کے.
madlad-400.back_translation: This is for %{crosstalk}, language exchange, listening practice, and general informal conversation, without forcing people into rigid modes or labels.

opus-mt.text: یہ %{crosstalk}، زبان کے تبادلے، سننے کی مشق، اور عام آرام دہ اور پرسکون گفتگو کے لئے لوگوں کو سخت طریقوں یا لیبلز میں مجبور کیے بغیر ہے.
opus-mt.back_translation: It's [ decreed] whether to exercise, hear, hear, and not to put people in harsh ways or calming conversations.

translategemma-12b.text: یہ %{crosstalk} کے لیے، زبان کی تبادلہ کے لیے، سننے کی مشق کے لیے، اور عام، دوستانہ گفتگو کے لیے بنایا گیا ہے، جس میں لوگوں پر کوئی پابندی یا مخصوص اصطلاحات थोپی نہیں جاتیں۔
translategemma-12b.back_translation: This platform is designed for language exchange, listening practice, and general, friendly conversation, without imposing any restrictions or specific terminology on users.

translategemma-27b.text: اس کا مقصد %{crosstalk}، لسانی تبادلہ، سننے کی مشق، اور عام، غیر رسمی گفتگو کو فروغ دینا ہے، جس میں لوگوں پر سختی سے کوئی خاص انداز یا شناخت مسلط نہ کی جائے۔
translategemma-27b.back_translation: Its purpose is to encourage spontaneous interaction, linguistic exchange, listening practice, and casual, informal conversation, without imposing any specific style or identity on the participants.

translategemma-4b.text: یہ مقصد لوگوں کو سخت قواعد یا لیبل کے تحت نہیں لانے، بلکہ %{crosstalk}، زبان کے تبادلے، سننے کی مشق، اور معمولی گفتگو کے لیے ہے۔
translategemma-4b.back_translation: The purpose is not to bring people under strict rules or labels, but rather to facilitate communication, language exchange, active listening, and casual conversation.

strings.msgid: A conversation lasts %{call} minutes. When time is up, it continues for another %{extension} minutes only if both people choose to, up to %{max} minutes in all. You can leave at any time.
strings.best_why: best of 6 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: بات چیت %{call} منٹ تک جاری رہے گی۔ وقت ختم ہونے کے بعد، اگر دونوں فریقین چاہیں تو یہ %{extension} منٹ تک مزید جاری رہ سکتی ہے، لیکن کل مدّت %{max} منٹ سے زیادہ نہیں ہوگی۔ آپ کسی بھی وقت بات چیت سے الگ ہو سکتے ہیں۔

hy-mt2.text: ایک گفتگو کا دورانیہ %{call} منٹ ہوتا ہے۔ جب یہ وقت ختم ہو جاتا ہے، تو اگر دونوں فریق راضی ہوں تو یہ مزید %{extension} منٹ تک جاری رہ سکتی ہے، کُل ملا کر %{max} منٹ تک۔ آپ کسی بھی وقت رخصت ہو سکتے ہیں۔
hy-mt2.back_translation: A conversation lasts for %{call} minutes. When this time is up, it can continue for another %{extension} minutes if both parties agree, for a total of up to %{max} minutes. You can end it at any time.

m2m100.text: ایک بات چیت %{call} منٹ تک جاری رہتی ہے جب وقت آتا ہے تو یہ ایک اور %{extension} منٹ تک جاری رہتا ہے صرف اگر دونوں لوگوں کو منتخب کرنے کے لئے، تک %{max} منٹ کل تک.
m2m100.back_translation: A word is continued until the time comes and it is continued until one and one %{extension} minutes only if the two people choose, until the whole %{max} minutes.

madlad-400.text: مکالمہ %{call} منٹ تک جاری رہتا ہے۔ جب وقت ختم ہوجاتا ہے تو، وہ مزید %{extension} منٹ تک جاری رہتا ہے اگر دونوں افراد اس کو منتخب کرلیں، مجموعی طور پر %{max} منٹ تک۔ آپ کسی بھی وقت چھوڑ سکتے ہیں۔
madlad-400.back_translation: The conversation continues for %{call} minutes. When the time runs out, it continues for another %{extension} minute if both persons choose it, up to a total of %{max} minutes. You can leave at any time

opus-mt.text: ایک بات چیت %{call} منٹ تک جاری رہتی ہے۔ جب وقت ختم ہوجاتا ہے تو ، یہ ایک اور %{extension} منٹ تک جاری رہتا ہے اگر دونوں ہی لوگ انتخاب کرتے ہیں ، %{max} منٹ تک۔ آپ کسی بھی وقت چھوڑ سکتے ہیں۔
opus-mt.back_translation: When the time is over, it continues another minute, if both people choose to choose, [2 minutes] you can leave at any time.

translategemma-12b.text: ایک گفتگو تقریباً %{call} منٹ تک جاری رہتی ہے۔ جب وقت ختم ہو جاتا ہے، تو یہ مزید %{extension} منٹ تک جاری رہ سکتی ہے، بشرطیکہ دونوں افراد اس سے اتفاق کریں، اور مجموعی طور پر یہ %{max} منٹ سے زیادہ نہیں ہو سکتی۔ آپ کسی بھی وقت گفتگو سے علیحدہ ہو سکتے ہیں۔
translategemma-12b.back_translation: A conversation typically lasts for approximately {call} minutes. If both parties agree, it can continue for an additional {extension} minutes, but the total duration cannot exceed {max} minutes. You can end the conversation at any time.

strings.key: The interface is quiet on purpose. The goal is low-pressure human presence, not performance or engagement loops.
strings.msgid: The interface is quiet on purpose. The goal is low-pressure human presence, not performance or engagement loops.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Giao diện được thiết kế đơn giản, không cầu kỳ. Mục tiêu là tạo ra một môi trường thân thiện, giảm áp lực cho người dùng, thay vì tập trung vào hiệu suất hay các tương tác liên tục.

hy-mt2.text: Giao diện được thiết kế sao cho yên tĩnh một cách cố ý. Mục tiêu là tạo cảm giác thoải mái cho người dùng, chứ không phải nhằm nâng cao hiệu suất hay tạo ra các vòng lặp tương tác.
hy-mt2.back_translation: The interface is intentionally designed to be quiet. The goal is to provide a comfortable feeling for users, rather than improving performance or creating interaction loops.

m2m100.text: Mục tiêu là sự hiện diện của con người với áp lực thấp, không phải hiệu suất hoặc tham gia.
m2m100.back_translation: The goal is the presence of people with low pressure, not performance or involvement.

madlad-400.text: Mục tiêu là sự hiện diện của con người với áp lực thấp, không phải là hiệu suất hay vòng lặp giao tiếp.
madlad-400.back_translation: The goal is the presence of humans at low pressure, not performance or communication loops.

opus-mt.text: Mục tiêu là sự hiện diện của con người thấp kém, không phải sự trình diễn hay sự gắn kết.
opus-mt.back_translation: The goal is that humans are inferior, not demonstrations or attachments.

translategemma-12b.text: Giao diện được thiết kế đơn giản, không cầu kỳ. Mục tiêu là tạo ra một môi trường thân thiện, giảm áp lực cho người dùng, thay vì tập trung vào hiệu suất hay các tương tác liên tục.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: The interface is designed to be simple and straightforward, avoiding unnecessary complexity. The goal is to create a user-friendly environment that reduces pressure on the user, rather than focusing on performance or constant interaction.

translategemma-27b.text: Giao diện được thiết kế đơn giản, có chủ ý để tạo cảm giác thư thái. Mục đích là để người dùng có thể tương tác một cách tự nhiên, thoải mái, chứ không phải để thúc đẩy các hoạt động liên tục hay tạo ra những trải nghiệm cường điệu.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: The interface is designed to be simple and intentional, creating a sense of calm. The goal is to allow users to interact naturally and comfortably, rather than to constantly encourage activity or create overly stimulating experiences.

translategemma-4b.text: Giao diện được thiết kế để không gây xao nhãng. Mục tiêu là tạo ra một môi trường làm việc yên tĩnh, tập trung vào hiệu suất và tương tác, chứ không phải là sự xao nhãng.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: The interface is designed to minimize distractions. The goal is to create a calm and focused work environment that prioritizes performance and interaction, rather than causing distractions.

strings.key: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.
strings.msgid: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Chúng tôi chỉ đếm số lượng cuộc gọi, không phải số lượng người. Chúng tôi không thu thập địa chỉ, thông tin cá nhân, hay bất kỳ dữ liệu nào về người gọi; chỉ ghi lại tổng số cuộc gọi.

hy-mt2.text: Chúng tôi đếm số cuộc gọi, chứ không phải số người: không có địa chỉ, không có mã ID, cũng chẳng có thông tin gì về bất kỳ ai; chỉ lưu lại những tổng số này thôi.
hy-mt2.back_translation: We count the number of calls, not the number of people: no addresses, no ID codes, and no information about anyone; only these totals are recorded.

m2m100.text: Chúng ta đếm các cuộc gọi, không phải mọi người: không có địa chỉ, không có ID, không có gì về bất cứ ai; chỉ có những tổng này được giữ lại.
m2m100.back_translation: We count the calls, not the people: no address, no ID, no thing about anyone; only these sum are retained.

madlad-400.text: Chúng tôi đếm cuộc gọi, không phải người: không có địa chỉ, không có ID, không có gì về bất kỳ ai; chỉ có những tổng này được giữ.
madlad-400.back_translation: We counted the calls, not the people: no addresses, no IDs, nothing about anyone; only these totals were kept.

opus-mt.text: Chúng tôi đếm cuộc gọi, không phải người: không địa chỉ, không địa chỉ, không có gì về bất cứ ai, chỉ có những tổng số này được giữ.
opus-mt.back_translation: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no addresses, nothing about anyone, just these numbers kept.

translategemma-12b.text: Chúng tôi chỉ đếm số lượng cuộc gọi, không phải số lượng người. Chúng tôi không thu thập địa chỉ, thông tin cá nhân, hay bất kỳ dữ liệu nào về người gọi; chỉ ghi lại tổng số cuộc gọi.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: We only count the number of calls, not the number of people. We do not collect addresses, personal information, or any data about the callers; we only record the total number of calls.

translategemma-27b.text: Chúng tôi chỉ thống kê số lượng cuộc gọi, chứ không phải số người; không ghi lại địa chỉ, không ghi lại thông tin cá nhân, không lưu trữ bất kỳ thông tin nào về người gọi; chỉ có tổng số cuộc gọi là được ghi lại.
translategemma-27b.back_translation: We only record the number of calls, not the number of callers; we do not record addresses, personal information, or store any information about the callers; only the total number of calls is recorded.

translategemma-4b.text: Chúng tôi ghi lại số lượng cuộc gọi, không phải thông tin về người gọi. Chúng tôi không lưu trữ địa chỉ, số nhận dạng, hoặc bất kỳ thông tin nào về người gọi. Chúng tôi chỉ lưu giữ các số liệu tổng hợp.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: We record the number of calls, not information about the caller. We do not store addresses, identification numbers, or any information about the caller. We only retain aggregate data.

strings.key: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.
strings.msgid: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.
strings.best_why: best of 7 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: 我们只统计通话次数，不记录任何个人信息：没有地址、没有身份信息，没有任何关于个人的数据；我们只保留这些总数。

hy-mt2.text: 我们统计的是通话次数，而非人数：没有地址，没有身份信息，也不会记录任何人的相关资料；仅保留这些总计数据。
hy-mt2.back_translation: We count the number of calls, not the number of people: there are no addresses, no identity information, and no records of anyone’s details; only these aggregate figures are kept.

m2m100.text: 我们计算电话,不是人:没有地址,没有ID,没有任何人;只有这些总数被保留。
m2m100.back_translation: We count the phone, not the person: no address, no ID, no one; only these total numbers are retained.

madlad-400.text: 我们计算的电话,而不是人:没有地址,没有ID,没有任何关于任何人;只有这些总和被保留。
madlad-400.back_translation: We calculate phone numbers, not people: no addresses, no IDs, nothing about anyone; only the sum of these is retained.

opus-mt.text: 我们数电话,而不是人:没有地址,没有身份证,没有任何人;只有这些总数。
opus-mt.back_translation: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no IDs, no people; that's all.

translategemma-12b.text: 我们只统计通话次数，不记录任何个人信息：没有地址、没有身份信息，没有任何关于个人的数据；我们只保留这些总数。
translategemma-12b.back_translation: We only track the number of calls made; we do not record any personal information. This means no addresses, no identification details, and no data whatsoever about individuals. We only retain these aggregate numbers.

translategemma-27b.text: 我们只统计通话次数，不记录个人信息：不收集任何地址、身份信息，甚至任何与通话人相关的信息；我们仅保存这些统计总数。
translategemma-27b.back_translation: We only track the number of calls and do not record any personal information. We do not collect any addresses, identification details, or even any information related to the callers themselves; we only retain these aggregated statistics.

translategemma-4b.text: 我们记录通话次数，而不是个人信息：我们不记录任何地址、身份证号码或其他任何个人信息，只记录这些总数。
translategemma-4b.back_translation: We only record the number of calls made, not any personal information. We do not record any addresses, ID numbers, or any other personal details; we only keep track of these totals.

strings.key: A language pair shows once it has at least %{min} calls; smaller ones are counted under “other”.
strings.msgid: A language pair shows once it has at least %{min} calls; smaller ones are counted under “other”.

strings.best_text: 当某对语言的调用次数达到至少 %{min} 次时才会被显示出来；调用次数较少的则归类为“其他”。

hy-mt2.text: 当某对语言的调用次数达到至少 %{min} 次时才会被显示出来；调用次数较少的则归类为“其他”。
hy-mt2.back_translation: A language pair will only be displayed when its call count reaches at least %{min} times; those with fewer calls are classified as “Other”.

m2m100.text: 一个语言对表示,一旦它至少有 %{min} 通话;较小的通话被计算为“其他”。

madlad-400.text: 一对语言在至少有 %{min} 次调用时显示;较少的调用计入“其他 ” 。

translategemma-12b.text: 只有当一个语言对的通话次数达到至少%{min}次时，才会单独列出；否则，这些数据将归入“其他”类别。
translategemma-12b.back_translation: A language pair will only be listed separately if the number of calls between that pair reaches at least %{min} times; otherwise, this data will be categorized under "Other."

translategemma-27b.text: 当某种语言对的调用次数达到%{min}次时，它就会被单独显示出来；低于此次数的语言对则会被归入“其他”类别。
translategemma-27b.back_translation: When the number of calls for a specific language pair reaches %{min} times, it will be displayed separately; language pairs with fewer calls will be grouped into an “Other” category.

translategemma-4b.text: 当一个语言对至少有%{min}次通话，则它会被识别出来。 较少的通话次数会被归类为“其他”。
